nodes.name: agent_org_run_events.rs
nodes.summary: Emits Tauri events to the frontend when an agent org run or its underlying session changes state, used to drive UI live-updates.

nodes.name: notify_agent_org_run_changed
nodes.summary: Emits a Tauri event notifying the frontend that a given agent org run's state has changed.

nodes.name: notify_agent_org_session_changed
nodes.summary: Resolves the owning agent org run for a session and emits a run-changed event, used when only a session id is known.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Helper functions for loading and mapping agent org run records (by id or root session), building run context objects, and validating run-related enum wire values.

nodes.name: parent_session_id_of
nodes.summary: Looks up the parent session id of a given session, used for walking up the session hierarchy.

nodes.name: load_by_id
nodes.summary: Loads a single agent org run record by its id.

nodes.name: load_by_root_session
nodes.summary: Loads the agent org run record associated with a given root session id.

nodes.name: row_to_run
nodes.summary: Maps a raw SQLite row into an AgentOrgRunRecord struct.

nodes.name: context_for_run_record
nodes.summary: Builds an AgentOrgRunContext (participants, routing info) from a run record plus the org store snapshot.

nodes.name: context_from_run_and_org
nodes.summary: Builds an AgentOrgRunContext directly from an already-loaded run and org snapshot, without a DB roundtrip.

nodes.name: flatten_members
nodes.summary: Recursively flattens a nested org member hierarchy into a flat list of AgentOrgContextMember entries with parent links.

nodes.name: insert_run
nodes.summary: Inserts a new agent org run row into SQLite from a run record.

nodes.name: validate_entry_mode
nodes.summary: Validates entry mode (agent org run helper/mapping functions).

nodes.name: validate_status
nodes.summary: Validates status (agent org run helper/mapping functions).

nodes.name: databases.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the database provider/connection configuration schema (SQLite, Supabase, Turso, Neon, Postgres, MySQL) and helpers for listing enabled connections.

nodes.name: enabled_connections
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of configured database connections whose `enabled` flag is set.

nodes.name: is_connection_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a specific database connection id is enabled in the configuration.

nodes.name: DatabaseProviderType
nodes.summary: Enum of supported database providers (Sqlite, Supabase, Turso, Neon, Postgres, Mysql) with Display formatting.

nodes.name: DatabaseConnectionEntry
nodes.summary: A single configured database connection: name, provider type, URL, read-only flag, and enabled flag.

nodes.name: DatabasesConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level databases configuration holding the list of connection entries plus lookup helpers.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the config submodules (databases, reliability) that make up the agent-core configuration surface.

nodes.name: reliability.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the reliability configuration controlling LLM call retries, backoff timing, and fallback model chains.

nodes.name: ReliabilityConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for LLM call retry behavior: max retries, base backoff milliseconds, and an ordered list of fallback models.

nodes.name: work_item_recovery.rs
nodes.summary: Startup recovery routine that marks any work items left in an interrupted state (from a previous crash/shutdown) back to a resumable state.

nodes.name: mark_all_interrupted_sync
nodes.summary: Synchronously marks all work items left in an interrupted state (from an unclean previous shutdown) back to a resumable state, run at application startup.

nodes.name: ade_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in 'ADE Manager' agent persona (system prompt, tools, policy) responsible for orchestrating other agents within the desktop app.

nodes.name: ade_manager
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in ADE Manager persona: its system prompt, allowed tools, and security policy for orchestrating other agents.

nodes.name: ai_research.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in 'AI Research' agent persona used for research-oriented tasks.

nodes.name: ai_research_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in AI Research persona, configured for research-oriented tool use.

nodes.name: base.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in generic 'base' agent persona used as a general-purpose fallback agent definition.

nodes.name: base_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in generic base persona used as a general-purpose fallback agent.

nodes.name: ds.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in 'Data Scientist' (ds) agent persona for data-analysis-oriented tasks.

nodes.name: ds_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in Data Scientist persona.

nodes.name: memory_consolidator.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in 'memory consolidator' agent persona responsible for summarizing/merging accumulated agent memory.

nodes.name: memory_consolidator
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in memory-consolidator persona that merges/summarizes accumulated agent memory.

nodes.name: memory_extractor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in 'memory extractor' agent persona responsible for extracting durable memory/learnings from session transcripts.

nodes.name: memory_extractor
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in memory-extractor persona that pulls durable learnings out of session transcripts.

nodes.name: subagents.rs
nodes.summary: Defines two built-in sub-agent personas ('explore' and 'general') used as delegated helper agents spawned by other agents.

nodes.name: explore_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in 'explore' sub-agent, a delegated helper for exploratory investigation tasks.

nodes.name: general_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in 'general' sub-agent, a delegated helper for general-purpose tasks.

nodes.name: wingman.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in 'Wingman' agent persona, a supportive/co-pilot style agent definition.

nodes.name: wingman_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the AgentDefinition for the built-in Wingman persona, a supportive co-pilot style agent.

nodes.name: microcompact.rs
nodes.summary: Implements lightweight 'microcompaction' that clears stale tool results and caps recent tool-call images to keep context size under a rolling token budget without a full LLM summarization pass.

nodes.name: evaluate_time_trigger
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a time-based microcompaction trigger should fire based on elapsed time and configured thresholds.

nodes.name: microcompact_messages
nodes.summary: Runs a microcompaction pass over the message list, clearing stale tool results and capping images per the configured budget.

nodes.name: force_microcompact_messages
nodes.summary: Forces a microcompaction pass regardless of normal trigger conditions, used for explicit/manual invocation.

nodes.name: clear_old_tool_results
nodes.summary: Clears the content of old tool-call results that fall outside the retention window, replacing them with lightweight placeholders to reduce token usage.

nodes.name: cap_recent_tool_images
nodes.summary: Caps the number/size of images retained in recent tool-call results to control image-heavy context bloat.

nodes.name: enforce_aggregate_budget
nodes.summary: Enforces an aggregate token budget across all tool results by progressively clearing older entries until under budget.

nodes.name: enforce_group_budget
nodes.summary: Enforces a per-group token budget on a specific subset of tool-result message indices.

nodes.name: MicrocompactConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the microcompaction feature (thresholds, retention windows), with defaults.

nodes.name: MicrocompactStats
nodes.summary: Statistics produced by a microcompaction pass (e.g., messages cleared, tokens saved).

nodes.name: ReplacementState
nodes.summary: Tracks which tool-result entries have already been cleared/replaced during microcompaction, to avoid re-processing.

nodes.name: patch.rs
nodes.summary: Defines partial-update patch types (AgentPolicyPatch, SessionModelPatch, AgentToolSelectionPatch, AgentDefinitionPatch) with apply() methods that merge optional overrides onto an existing agent definition, gated by builtin-agent restrictions.

nodes.name: AgentPolicyPatch
nodes.summary: Partial-update patch for AgentPolicy fields (e.g., autonomy level, risk rules), applied on top of an existing policy via apply().

nodes.name: SessionModelPatch
nodes.summary: Partial-update patch for the SessionModel (LLM provider/model selection) fields, merged onto an existing session model via apply().

nodes.name: AgentToolSelectionPatch
nodes.summary: Partial-update patch for an agent's tool selection/allow-deny configuration, merged via apply().

nodes.name: AgentDefinitionPatch
nodes.summary: Top-level partial-update patch aggregating policy, model, and tool-selection patches for an AgentDefinition, with builtin-agent gating (gate_for_builtin) and an apply() that merges all sub-patches.

nodes.name: sections.rs
nodes.summary: Analyzes session-memory section sizes against token budgets, generates section-size reminders, and truncates/flushes oversized sections.

nodes.name: analyze_section_sizes
nodes.summary: Parses session-memory content into named sections and estimates the token size of each.

nodes.name: generate_section_reminders
nodes.summary: Generates reminder text flagging session-memory sections that exceed their configured token budgets.

nodes.name: truncate_for_compact
nodes.summary: Truncates session-memory content down to fit within a per-section token budget ahead of compaction.

nodes.name: flush_section
nodes.summary: Flushes an accumulated section's lines into a bounded-length text block under a header, splitting or truncating as needed.

nodes.name: SmSection
nodes.summary: Represents a single named section of session-memory content along with its accumulated lines/size.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the model_context subsystem, re-exporting cleanup, compaction, file_reinjection, microcompact, plan_preservation, session_memory, summarization, and tokenizer.

nodes.name: orgs.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the org/team hierarchy data model (OrgDefinition, OrgMember, hierarchy modes, plan-approval policy) and the AgentOrgsStore responsible for loading, persisting, and validating orgs, including default SDE/DS template teams.

nodes.name: orgs_store
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide lazily-initialized AgentOrgsStore singleton used to access org/team definitions.

nodes.name: parse_cli_agent_org_reference
nodes.summary: Parses a CLI-style agent id string to extract an org/team reference (org name and optional member path), if the id follows the CLI org-reference convention.

nodes.name: apply_overrides_to_member_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively walks an org member tree applying launch overrides (e.g., model, workspace) to matching members and their descendants.

nodes.name: apply_overrides_to_members
nodes.summary: Applies a set of member launch overrides to a flat list of org members, tracking which member ids were successfully matched.

nodes.name: ensure_default_template_team
nodes.summary: Ensures the default template team orgs (e.g. SDE, DS) exist in the store, creating or refreshing them if missing or stale.

nodes.name: ensure_default_org
nodes.summary: Generic helper that ensures a given default org exists and is up to date, using the provided builder and staleness-check closures.

nodes.name: default_sde_template_team_is_current
nodes.summary: Checks whether an existing SDE (software engineering) template org matches the current default template shape, to decide if it needs regeneration.

nodes.name: default_sde_template_team
nodes.summary: Builds the default 'SDE' template org, a preconfigured hierarchy of software-engineering agent roles.

nodes.name: default_ds_template_team_is_current
nodes.summary: Checks whether an existing DS (data science) template org matches the current default template shape.

nodes.name: default_ds_template_team
nodes.summary: Builds the default 'DS' (data science) template org, a preconfigured hierarchy of data-science agent roles.

nodes.name: load_from_disk
nodes.summary: Loads the orgs store contents from a JSON file on disk, returning the deserialized set of org definitions.

nodes.name: save_to_disk
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the current org definitions to disk at the given path.

nodes.name: HierarchyMode
nodes.summary: Enum describing how an org's member hierarchy is structured (e.g., flat vs. nested reporting lines).

nodes.name: PlanApprovalPolicy
nodes.summary: Enum/struct describing the plan-approval policy for an org (e.g., who must approve a plan before execution), with an as_wire() conversion for the frontend.

nodes.name: OrgMemberRuntimeConfig
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration overrides for an individual org member (e.g., model, workspace, tool selection) applied at launch time.

nodes.name: OrgMemberLaunchOverride
nodes.summary: Represents a single launch-time override targeted at a specific org member or subtree.

nodes.name: OrgMember
nodes.summary: Represents one member (agent) within an org hierarchy, including its role and nested sub-members.

nodes.name: OrgDefinition
nodes.summary: Top-level org/team definition containing the member hierarchy, hierarchy mode, and plan-approval policy, with helpers to count members recursively.

nodes.name: AgentOrgsStore
nodes.summary: In-memory store for all org/team definitions, providing CRUD (insert/replace/remove), persistence, agent-reference validation, and launch-override application.

nodes.name: store.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AgentDefinitionsStore, the persistence layer that loads/saves agent definitions and override deltas to disk, composes builtins with overrides, and migrates legacy workspace settings.

nodes.name: definitions_store
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide lazily-initialized AgentDefinitionsStore singleton.

nodes.name: migrate_legacy_workspace_settings
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy on-disk workspace-settings JSON shapes into the current agent-definition schema during load.

nodes.name: migrate_stale_summary_max_tokens
nodes.summary: Migrates stale/legacy summary-max-tokens configuration values found in persisted definitions to the current schema.

nodes.name: load_from_disk
nodes.summary: Loads the full set of agent definitions from disk, applying legacy migrations as needed.

nodes.name: save_to_disk
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the current set of agent definitions to disk.

nodes.name: load_overrides_from_disk
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted override-delta file (user customizations layered on top of builtin agent definitions) from disk.

nodes.name: compose_builtin_with_delta
nodes.summary: Composes a builtin agent definition with a stored override delta to produce the effective definition for that id.

nodes.name: delta_against_builtin
nodes.summary: Computes the override delta between an effective (current) agent definition and its builtin baseline, for persistence.

nodes.name: save_overrides_to_disk
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the override-delta map to disk.

nodes.name: AgentDefinitionsStore
nodes.summary: In-memory store for all agent definitions (builtin + overrides), providing CRUD, snapshotting, overlay updates, builtin reset, and disk persistence.

nodes.name: file_reinjection.rs
nodes.summary: Extracts recently-read files from conversation history and re-injects file-reference reminders into the message stream after compaction to preserve file-awareness.

nodes.name: extract_recently_read_files
nodes.summary: Scans recent messages for file-read tool results and extracts the set of file paths that were recently read, to preserve file-awareness across compaction.

nodes.name: is_excluded_from_reinjection
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given file path should be excluded from post-compaction reinjection (e.g., binary files, excluded directories).

nodes.name: message_text
nodes.summary: Extracts plain text content from a message's value/output representation.

nodes.name: truncate_at_boundary
nodes.summary: Truncates file content to a maximum byte size at a safe character boundary, avoiding mid-character splits.

nodes.name: build_file_reinjection_messages_with_preserved_tail
nodes.summary: Builds the set of synthetic reminder messages that re-inject recently-read file references after compaction, while preserving the untouched message tail.

nodes.name: reinject_files_after_compaction
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that reinjects recently-read file reminders into the compacted message history based on what was read before compaction.

nodes.name: file_registry.rs
nodes.summary: Maintains a registry of active session files on disk, supporting registration, unregistration, listing, and cleanup of stale session entries.

nodes.name: register_session
nodes.summary: Registers a new active session in the on-disk session registry, recording its metadata for crash-recovery/cleanup purposes.

nodes.name: unregister_session
nodes.summary: Removes a session's entry from the on-disk session registry once it has ended.

nodes.name: list_registered_sessions
nodes.summary: Lists all sessions currently recorded in the on-disk registry.

nodes.name: cleanup_stale_sessions
nodes.summary: Removes registry entries for sessions that are no longer active, given the current set of active session ids.

nodes.name: SessionRegistryEntry
nodes.summary: A single entry in the session registry file, recording a session's id and associated metadata (e.g., process/workspace info).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the core crate that re-exports config, coordination, definitions, interaction, model_context, providers, session, side_query, tools, and turn_executor submodules.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Defines default configuration structs (SessionMemoryConfig, SessionMemoryCompactConfig) controlling thresholds for the session-memory compaction feature.

nodes.name: SessionMemoryConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level configuration for the session-memory feature (extraction thresholds, enablement), with defaults.

nodes.name: SessionMemoryCompactConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration specific to session-memory-driven compaction (keep ratios, boundaries), with defaults.

nodes.name: learnings_lookup.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves accumulated learnings text for a given agent/session context, providing a small lookup helper used during agent definition resolution.

nodes.name: resolve_learnings_for
nodes.summary: Resolves the accumulated learnings text applicable to a given agent id by looking up stored learnings entries relevant to that agent.

nodes.name: summarization.rs
nodes.summary: Builds LLM summarization prompts from conversation history and drives summarize_messages/summarize_messages_forked via a side-query to produce compaction summaries, with validation of the returned summary.

nodes.name: truncate_for_summary
nodes.summary: Truncates arbitrary text to a maximum character length before including it in a summarization prompt.

nodes.name: flatten_content_text
nodes.summary: Flattens a structured message content block into a single plain-text string for summarization purposes.

nodes.name: format_messages_for_summary_refs
nodes.summary: Formats the conversation history into a compact textual representation used as input to the summarization prompt.

nodes.name: format_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Formats a message's tool calls into readable text for inclusion in the summarization prompt.

nodes.name: build_summary_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the full LLM prompt used to request a conversation summary, optionally including custom instructions and the prior summary for continuity.

nodes.name: validate_summary
nodes.summary: Validates an LLM-produced summary for completeness (e.g., checking finish_reason and output length against the configured cap).

nodes.name: summarize_messages_forked
nodes.summary: Runs LLM summarization for the forked-compaction path, issuing a side-query against the given provider and returning the summary result.

nodes.name: summarize_messages
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that summarizes a message history via an LLM side-query, applying the configured token budget and custom instructions.

nodes.name: ForkSummaryInputs
nodes.summary: Bundled inputs (messages, state, model) required to run the forked-compaction summarization path.

nodes.name: compaction.rs
nodes.summary: Core context-window compaction engine (ContextCompactor) implementing trigger detection, adaptive keep-ratio calculation, forked/manual compaction attempts, summary acceptance, and prompt-too-long recovery/calibration.

nodes.name: CompactionConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the compaction engine (trigger ratio, keep ratio, summary token budget, minimum messages, floor/reserved/buffer tokens), with defaults and an effective_budget() calculation.

nodes.name: CompactionState
nodes.summary: Tracks the current compaction-related state of a session (e.g., last compacted index, recompaction info).

nodes.name: RecompactionInfo
nodes.summary: Metadata describing a prior recompaction event, used to decide whether/how to recompact.

nodes.name: CompactionOutcome
nodes.summary: Result type describing the outcome of a compaction attempt (success, boundaries, token counts, or failure reason).

nodes.name: ContextCompactor
nodes.summary: Core compaction engine: detects when compaction is needed (needs_compaction*), performs standard/forked/manual compaction attempts (compact, compact_with_fork, compact_manual_force, try_compact), accepts LLM-produced summaries, and recovers from prompt-too-long errors via budget calibration and truncation.

nodes.name: fork.rs
nodes.summary: Implements attempt_fork, which forks session state during compaction by writing a new session record/file rather than mutating history in place.

nodes.name: attempt_fork
nodes.summary: Attempts to fork the current session during compaction: writes a new forked session record so compaction can proceed without mutating the original session's history in place.

nodes.name: build_forked_record
nodes.summary: Builds the new session record metadata for a forked session, linking it back to the original session id.

nodes.name: ForkOutcome
nodes.summary: Result type describing the outcome of a fork attempt (success with new session id, or failure reason).

nodes.name: ForkInputs
nodes.summary: Bundled inputs required to attempt a session fork (original session id, messages, compaction context).

nodes.name: prefix_lookup.rs
nodes.summary: Provides lookup helpers that map session IDs to builtin agent definition prefixes, including workspace-personal and wingman session detection.

nodes.name: session_prefix_for_launch
nodes.summary: Determines the session id prefix to use when launching a session for a given agent definition, factoring in whether a workspace path is present.

nodes.name: BuiltinPrefixEntry
nodes.summary: Maps a builtin agent definition id to its session-id prefix convention.

nodes.name: cleanup.rs
nodes.summary: Performs post-compaction cleanup of stale tool-call state by collecting and clearing tool_call_ids no longer referenced in the trimmed message history.

nodes.name: post_compact_cleanup
nodes.summary: Cleans up tool-call bookkeeping state after a compaction pass by removing entries for tool_call_ids no longer present in the trimmed message history.

nodes.name: collect_tool_call_ids
nodes.summary: Walks a message list and collects the set of tool_call_ids referenced within it, used to determine which tool-call state entries are still live.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the session compaction subsystem, re-exporting fork, manual, and persist submodules.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Declares the core serializable schema types for agent definitions (SessionMode, SessionModel, AgentPolicy, AgentToolSelection, DelegationConfig, AgentDefinition, learnings config) used across the definitions subsystem.

nodes.name: SessionMode
nodes.summary: Enum of the supported session execution modes (e.g. normal, read-only) used to gate tool access.

nodes.name: SessionModel
nodes.summary: Schema struct describing which LLM provider/model a session or agent should use, with sensible defaults.

nodes.name: AgentTier
nodes.summary: Enum classifying an agent's tier/role level within the system.

nodes.name: AgentPolicy
nodes.summary: Schema struct capturing an agent's autonomy level, command-risk rules, and other security policy fields, convertible to a runtime SecurityPolicy via to_runtime_security().

nodes.name: SubAgentIsolation
nodes.summary: Enum describing the isolation level applied to sub-agents spawned by this agent (e.g., shared vs isolated workspace).

nodes.name: SubAgentRef
nodes.summary: Reference to a sub-agent definition that this agent is permitted to delegate to.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsConfig
nodes.summary: Schema struct configuring which skills are enabled/available for an agent and their loading behavior.

nodes.name: AgentToolSelection
nodes.summary: Schema struct describing an agent's allowed/denied tool set and related tool-use configuration.

nodes.name: DelegationConfig
nodes.summary: Schema struct configuring how and whether an agent may delegate work to sub-agents, with defaults.

nodes.name: AgentDefinition
nodes.summary: The core serializable schema describing a full agent definition: identity, policy, session model, tools, skills, delegation, and capabilities. Central type of the definitions subsystem.

nodes.name: AgentLearningsConfig
nodes.summary: Schema struct configuring how an agent's learnings (accumulated knowledge) are stored and surfaced, with defaults.

nodes.name: resolver.rs
nodes.summary: Implements recursive resolution and merging of agent definitions, combining a definition with its parent/base definitions across capabilities, session model, agent policy, tools, skills, and delegation config.

nodes.name: get_raw_definition
nodes.summary: Fetches the raw, unresolved AgentDefinition for a given agent id from the definitions store.

nodes.name: resolve_with_depth
nodes.summary: Recursively resolves an agent definition against its parent chain up to a maximum depth, guarding against cycles via a visited set.

nodes.name: merge_definitions
nodes.summary: Merges a child agent definition onto its parent, combining capabilities, session model, policy, tools, skills, and delegation config field-by-field.

nodes.name: merge_capabilities
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child capability sets (coding, desktop, browser, etc.) for a resolved agent definition.

nodes.name: merge_coding_cap
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child coding-capability configuration.

nodes.name: merge_desktop_cap
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child desktop-capability configuration.

nodes.name: merge_browser_cap
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child browser-capability configuration.

nodes.name: merge_session_model
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child SessionModel settings, letting the child override the parent's model/provider choice where specified.

nodes.name: merge_agent_policy
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child AgentPolicy settings such as autonomy level and risk rules.

nodes.name: merge_tools
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child tool-selection configuration, combining allow/deny lists.

nodes.name: merge_skills_config
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child skills configuration.

nodes.name: merge_delegation_config
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child sub-agent delegation configuration.

nodes.name: messages.rs
nodes.summary: Converts internal message representations into Anthropic-native wire format, extracting system blocks, applying prompt-cache-control markers, and producing sidecar sibling content blocks.

nodes.name: extract_system
nodes.summary: Extracts and separates system-prompt content from the message list when converting to Anthropic's native wire format, handling cache-control markers.

nodes.name: render_system_blocks
nodes.summary: Renders the extracted system-prompt parts into Anthropic's system-block wire format, applying prompt-cache-control where appropriate.

nodes.name: stamp_trailing_cache_control
nodes.summary: Stamps a cache_control marker on the trailing eligible content block(s) of the message list to enable Anthropic prompt caching.

nodes.name: strip_cache_scope_markers
nodes.summary: Strips internal cache-scope markers from messages before sending them to the Anthropic API.

nodes.name: finalize_wire_hygiene
nodes.summary: Performs final cleanup/normalization passes on the message list to ensure it is well-formed for the Anthropic wire format.

nodes.name: anthropic_thinking_block
nodes.summary: Converts an internal thinking/reasoning representation associated with a tool call into an Anthropic-native thinking content block.

nodes.name: convert_content_block
nodes.summary: Converts a single internal content block into its Anthropic-native wire representation.

nodes.name: sidecar_to_anthropic_sibling_blocks
nodes.summary: Converts internal 'sidecar' content (auxiliary data attached to a message) into the sibling content blocks expected by the Anthropic API.

nodes.name: persist.rs
nodes.summary: Persists compact-boundary markers into the session file in place, splitting summary and tail content and detecting already-compacted sessions.

nodes.name: content_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain-text content of a message for persistence/boundary-marker purposes.

nodes.name: split_summary_and_tail
nodes.summary: Splits a compacted message list into the summary portion and the preserved tail portion for persistence.

nodes.name: append_in_place_compact_boundary
nodes.summary: Appends a compact-boundary marker to the session's persisted message log in place, recording the token delta from compaction.

nodes.name: persist_session_memory_after_compact
nodes.summary: Persists any extracted session-memory content to disk immediately after a compaction pass completes.

nodes.name: AppendedCompactBoundary
nodes.summary: Result describing the compact-boundary marker that was appended to a session's persisted log.

nodes.name: manual.rs
nodes.summary: Drives user-triggered manual compaction (run_manual_compact), producing a ManualCompactResult/Summary and persisting the outcome to session state.

nodes.name: run_manual_compact
nodes.summary: Drives a user-triggered manual compaction of a session: loads state, runs the compactor, persists the result, and returns a summary.

nodes.name: ManualCompactResult
nodes.summary: Result of a manual-compaction request, including the resulting summary/status returned to the frontend.

nodes.name: ManualCompactSummary
nodes.summary: Summary statistics for a completed manual compaction (e.g., messages compacted, tokens saved).

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Provides token-counting utilities (count_tokens, count_message_tokens) backed by a per-model tokenizer encoder, used to size messages against context budgets.

nodes.name: encoder_for_model
nodes.summary: Selects and returns the appropriate token encoder for a given LLM model identifier.

nodes.name: count_with_encoder
nodes.summary: Counts the number of tokens in a text string using a specific pre-selected encoder.

nodes.name: count_content_tokens
nodes.summary: Counts the tokens represented by a structured message content block (text, tool calls, etc.).

nodes.name: count_message_tokens
nodes.summary: Counts the total tokens in a single message including its content and metadata overhead.

nodes.name: plan_preservation.rs
nodes.summary: Detects plan-bearing messages and re-injects the active plan back into context after compaction so in-progress task plans survive summarization.

nodes.name: extract_active_plan
nodes.summary: Scans recent messages for the most recent plan-bearing content (e.g., an active TODO/plan tool call) and extracts it.

nodes.name: reinject_plan_after_compaction
nodes.summary: Re-injects the most recent active plan into the message history after compaction so in-progress plans aren't lost.

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.summary: Barrel module for the L3 consolidation engine that documents the drain-and-decide flow and re-exports the public surface (consolidate, EventCounts, spawn_consolidation_tick, ConsolidationTrigger) from its private submodules.

nodes.name: recall.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the two candidate-recall strategies used before an LLM decision: embedding similarity search (Mode A) and manifest/salience-ranked keyword shortlisting (Mode B).

nodes.name: tests_support.rs
nodes.summary: Test-only helpers that spin up an in-memory SQLite connection with the learnings/session schema and construct PendingLearning fixtures for consolidation unit tests.

nodes.name: triggers.rs
nodes.summary: Policy functions deciding whether a consolidation run should fire: lazy (pending-count + time threshold), forced (manual/any pending), and idle (session gap heuristics), plus an e2e-test scope guard.

nodes.name: abandon_after_consolidation_failure
nodes.summary: Marks a pending learning as abandoned and records the failure reason when a batch aborts due to a capacity error.

nodes.name: consolidate_batch
nodes.summary: Iterates every pending learning in a batch, recalling candidates, requesting an LLM decision via side_query_typed, and applying the resulting event, aborting early on capacity errors.

nodes.name: resolve_batch_provider_info
nodes.summary: Determines the LLM provider and model to use for a consolidation batch, falling back to the account default when not explicitly overridden.

nodes.name: resolve_provider
nodes.summary: Maps a resolved model/account_id pair to a concrete LLM provider instance.

nodes.name: resolve_embed_mode
nodes.summary: Probes the embedding provider once per batch to decide whether candidate recall should use embedding similarity (Mode A) or manifest ranking (Mode B).

nodes.name: BatchContext
nodes.summary: Groups the resolved scope, provider, model, candidate mode, and embedding provider shared across every row processed in one consolidation batch.

nodes.name: BatchProviderInfo
nodes.summary: Holds the model and account_id resolved for a consolidation batch's LLM calls.

nodes.name: build_decision_prompt
nodes.summary: Constructs the mem0-style LLM prompt presenting a new fact and its candidate learnings, asking for an ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NONE decision as JSON.

nodes.name: levenshtein_capped
nodes.summary: Computes Levenshtein edit distance between two strings, short-circuiting once it exceeds a given cap for performance.

nodes.name: fuzzy_correct_id
nodes.summary: Corrects a possibly-hallucinated candidate ID returned by the LLM to the nearest real candidate ID using capped edit distance.

nodes.name: parse_decision
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's JSON decision response into a ResolvedDecision, applying fuzzy ID correction against the known candidate set.

nodes.name: DecisionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of the four possible mem0 consolidation decisions: Add, Update, Delete, or None.

nodes.name: RawDecision
nodes.summary: Deserialized shape of the raw JSON decision returned by the LLM before candidate-ID fuzzy correction.

nodes.name: ResolvedDecision
nodes.summary: Final decision after fuzzy ID correction, pairing a DecisionEvent with its resolved target learning ID and text.

nodes.name: consolidate
nodes.summary: Top-level consolidation entry point: loads pending learnings for a scope, groups them per billing account, resolves provider/embedding mode per group, drives consolidate_batch, and records a consolidation_runs row.

nodes.name: apply_event
nodes.summary: Applies a resolved consolidation decision to the learnings store: promotes/adds on Add, merges on Update, deprecates on Delete, or abandons on None, tallying EventCounts.

nodes.name: EventCounts
nodes.summary: Tallies of how many learnings were added, updated, deleted, left unchanged, or abandoned during a consolidation batch.

nodes.name: recall_mode_embedding
nodes.summary: Embeds the new fact and runs a vector similarity search over active learnings to shortlist consolidation candidates (Mode A).

nodes.name: recall_mode_manifest
nodes.summary: Shortlists consolidation candidates without embeddings by loading active learnings and ranking them by salience score (Mode B).

nodes.name: setup_conn
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory SQLite connection with the session/learnings schema initialized for use in consolidation unit tests.

nodes.name: pending
nodes.summary: Builds a PendingLearning test fixture with a computed content hash for a given scope and content string.

nodes.name: lazy_trigger_ready
nodes.summary: Returns true when a scope has enough pending learnings and enough elapsed time since the last consolidation to justify a lazy trigger.

nodes.name: forced_trigger_ready
nodes.summary: Returns true whenever there is at least one pending learning anywhere, used for manually forced consolidation.

nodes.name: idle_trigger_ready
nodes.summary: Returns true when the system has been idle long enough (no recent session activity) to justify running consolidation in the background.

nodes.name: is_e2e_learnings_test_scope
nodes.summary: Identifies scopes reserved for end-to-end learnings tests so production trigger policy can special-case them.

nodes.name: frontmatter.rs
nodes.summary: Parses the YAML-style frontmatter header (key: value lines between --- delimiters) at the top of a workspace-memory markdown file.

nodes.name: manifest.rs
nodes.summary: Scans the workspace-memory directory recursively into a list of MemoryHeader entries, formats them into the MEMORY.md manifest with freshness annotations, and loads/truncates the index file itself.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root of the L2 workspace-scoped memory system (markdown files with YAML frontmatter under .orgii/workspace-memory/): defines MemoryType and MemoryHeader, workspace path helpers, a personal-workspace migration routine, and re-exports auto_dream/extract/lock/prefetch/surface_state plus flattened frontmatter/manifest helpers.

nodes.name: prefetch.rs
nodes.summary: Session-start memory prefetch: an LLM side-query (select_relevant_headers) picks the most relevant workspace-memory files for the user's first message, with an offline fallback, then assembles the memory protocol/prompt sections injected into the agent system prompt.

nodes.name: prompt_sections.rs
nodes.summary: Static, eval-validated prompt-text constants describing memory types, save/skip guidance, and access rules, exposed via how_to_save_section for injection into the agent system prompt.

nodes.name: surface_state.rs
nodes.summary: WorkspaceMemorySurfaceState tracks which memory file paths have already been surfaced to the agent within a session (bounded insertion-ordered dedup set) plus a running injected-byte budget.

nodes.name: parse_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Parses the leading --- delimited YAML-style frontmatter block of a workspace-memory markdown file into a key/value map.

nodes.name: scan_memory_files
nodes.summary: Recursively scans a workspace-memory directory and returns MemoryHeader entries sorted by most-recently-modified.

nodes.name: scan_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursive directory walker collecting markdown files and parsing their frontmatter into headers.

nodes.name: format_memory_manifest
nodes.summary: Formats a list of memory headers into the markdown manifest block used in prompts and the MEMORY.md index.

nodes.name: format_timestamp_iso
nodes.summary: Converts a millisecond epoch timestamp into an ISO-8601 formatted date/time string without relying on chrono for this hot path.

nodes.name: load_memory_index
nodes.summary: Loads and parses the MEMORY.md index file for a workspace, falling back gracefully when absent.

nodes.name: truncate_entrypoint
nodes.summary: Truncates the MEMORY.md index content to the configured maximum line count before prompt injection.

nodes.name: memory_age_days
nodes.summary: Computes a memory file's age in whole days from its mtime.

nodes.name: memory_age
nodes.summary: Computes a memory file's age as a duration from its mtime.

nodes.name: memory_freshness_text
nodes.summary: Formats a memory file's mtime into a human-readable freshness label for prompt display.

nodes.name: memory_dir
nodes.summary: Computes the .orgii/workspace-memory/ directory path for a given workspace root.

nodes.name: is_memory_path
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given file path lies inside a workspace's memory directory.

nodes.name: migrate_personal_workspace_memory
nodes.summary: One-time migration routine that moves legacy personal-workspace memory files into the current memory directory layout.

nodes.name: build_memory_policy
nodes.summary: Builds the effective memory policy (limits/toggles) used to gate prefetch, extraction, and auto-dream for the current session.

nodes.name: MemoryType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a workspace-memory file: User, Feedback, Workspace, or Reference.

nodes.name: MemoryHeader
nodes.summary: Scanned metadata for one workspace-memory file: filename, path, mtime, description, and memory type.

nodes.name: select_memories
nodes.summary: Main prefetch entry point: scans available memory headers and uses an LLM side-query to select the subset most relevant to the user's first message, respecting a byte budget.

nodes.name: select_memories_offline
nodes.summary: Offline fallback for memory prefetch that selects recent memory headers without an LLM call when no provider is available.

nodes.name: select_relevant_headers
nodes.summary: Issues the LLM side-query asking it to pick the most relevant memory filenames from the manifest given the user query and recent tool activity.

nodes.name: extract_recent_tools_from_history
nodes.summary: Extracts a de-duplicated list of recently used tool names from the conversation history to give the selection LLM extra context.

nodes.name: parse_selected_filenames
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's selection response text into a list of chosen memory filenames.

nodes.name: load_selected_memories
nodes.summary: Loads the file contents for the selected memory headers, up to a maximum count and byte budget.

nodes.name: truncate_memory_to_file_budget
nodes.summary: Truncates a single memory file's content to stay within its allotted portion of the prompt byte budget.

nodes.name: build_memory_protocol_section
nodes.summary: Assembles the "how memory works" protocol section of the system prompt, describing save/access rules.

nodes.name: build_memory_prompt_section
nodes.summary: Assembles the final memory prompt section injected into the agent system prompt, combining the manifest and selected memory contents.

nodes.name: RelevantMemory
nodes.summary: A memory file selected during prefetch, paired with its path, mtime, content, and freshness label.

nodes.name: how_to_save_section
nodes.summary: Returns the static, eval-validated prompt text instructing the agent how and when to save workspace-memory files.

nodes.name: WorkspaceMemorySurfaceState
nodes.summary: Bounded, insertion-ordered set of memory paths already surfaced to the agent this session, plus a running injected-byte counter, used to avoid re-injecting the same memory twice.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the small enums shared across the consolidation engine: ConsolidationTrigger (Idle/Lazy/Forced/Manual) and CandidateMode (Embedding/Manifest), each with a string round-trip.

nodes.name: auto.rs
nodes.summary: AutoEmbeddingProvider resolves and caches the best available embedding backend (local, OpenAI, or Azure) based on integrations config and agent type, then delegates embed/embed_batch calls to it.
nodes.languageNotes: Caches the resolved provider behind a tokio::sync::Mutex so repeated embed calls avoid re-resolving configuration.

nodes.name: azure.rs
nodes.summary: AzureEmbeddingProvider implements the EmbeddingProvider trait by calling the Azure OpenAI embeddings REST endpoint via reqwest.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the EmbeddingProvider trait and EmbeddingResult struct shared by all embedding backends, plus a cosine_similarity utility used for vector search, and re-exports the auto/azure/openai submodules.

nodes.name: openai.rs
nodes.summary: OpenAIEmbeddingProvider implements the EmbeddingProvider trait by calling the OpenAI embeddings REST endpoint via reqwest.

nodes.name: crud.rs
nodes.summary: Base read/write operations on the learnings SQLite table: insert_learning, load_active_learnings, load_learning_by_id, a row-to-struct mapper, and content-hash-based dedup (Reinforced vs Novel).

nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Status-transition API for learnings and consolidation runs: loading pending/active candidates, promoting, merging, abandoning, touch-recall bookkeeping, deprecating/reactivating, editing, deleting, and writing consolidation_runs ledger rows.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the L3 learnings store documenting its table schema and layout, exposing scope_for_agent(agent_id) and re-exporting crud/lifecycle/prompt/ranking/schema/stats/types plus shared test setup helpers.

nodes.name: prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Renders ranked learnings into the agent system prompt: freshness/reinforcement badges, per-line caps, the main format_learnings_for_prompt formatter, and inject_learnings_into_prompt which drives embedding-based recall and schedules a background touch_recall.

nodes.name: ConsolidationTrigger
nodes.summary: Enum identifying why a consolidation run fired: Idle, Lazy, Forced, or Manual, with an as_str round-trip.

nodes.name: CandidateMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting the candidate-recall strategy for a batch: Embedding (vector search) or Manifest (salience ranking).

nodes.name: AutoEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation that lazily resolves and caches the best available backend (local/OpenAI/Azure) based on config and agent type.

nodes.name: AzureEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation backed by the Azure OpenAI embeddings REST API.

nodes.name: cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes the cosine similarity between two embedding vectors, used to rank candidate learnings/memories by relevance.

nodes.name: EmbeddingResult
nodes.summary: Return value of an embedding call: the vector, its dimensionality, and the model used to produce it.

nodes.name: EmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by every embedding backend (auto/openai/azure), exposing embed, embed_batch, dimensions, and provider_name.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation backed by the OpenAI embeddings REST API.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbedRequest
nodes.summary: Request body shape for the OpenAI embeddings endpoint.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbedResponse
nodes.summary: Top-level response shape returned by the OpenAI embeddings endpoint.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbedData
nodes.summary: A single embedding vector entry within an OpenAI embeddings response.

nodes.name: insert_learning
nodes.summary: Inserts a new learning row into the learnings table, generating an ID and timestamps when not already set.

nodes.name: load_active_learnings
nodes.summary: Loads all learnings with status=active for a given agent scope.

nodes.name: load_learning_by_id
nodes.summary: Loads a single learning row by its primary key ID.

nodes.name: row_to_learning
nodes.summary: Maps a SQLite row into a Learning struct, deserializing enum and optional columns.

nodes.name: content_hash_dedup
nodes.summary: Checks whether a new learning's content hash already exists for the scope/category and either reinforces the existing row or signals a novel insert.

nodes.name: DedupResult
nodes.summary: Enum result of content-hash dedup: Reinforced (matched an existing learning) or Novel (no match, safe to insert).

nodes.name: load_pending_learnings
nodes.summary: Loads all learnings with status=pending for a scope, awaiting consolidation.

nodes.name: load_active_candidates
nodes.summary: Loads active learnings for a scope to serve as consolidation-decision candidates.

nodes.name: count_pending_learnings
nodes.summary: Counts pending learnings across all scopes.

nodes.name: count_pending_for_scope
nodes.summary: Counts pending learnings for a specific agent scope.

nodes.name: last_consolidation_at
nodes.summary: Reads the timestamp of the most recent consolidation run for a scope.

nodes.name: promote_pending_to_active
nodes.summary: Transitions a pending learning to active status after an Add decision.

nodes.name: mark_merged
nodes.summary: Marks a pending learning as merged into an existing active learning after an Update decision.

nodes.name: abandon_pending
nodes.summary: Marks a pending learning as abandoned, used on Delete/None decisions or consolidation failure.

nodes.name: touch_recall
nodes.summary: Updates a learning's last-recalled timestamp and reinforcement count after it is surfaced in a prompt.

nodes.name: record_consolidation_run
nodes.summary: Writes a consolidation_runs ledger row summarizing counts, trigger, mode, and timing for a completed run.

nodes.name: deprecate_learning
nodes.summary: Marks an active learning as deprecated so it stops being surfaced.

nodes.name: reactivate_learning
nodes.summary: Restores a deprecated/merged learning back to active status.

nodes.name: update_learning_body
nodes.summary: Edits a learning's takeaway/content, recomputing its content hash to keep dedup consistent.

nodes.name: delete_learning
nodes.summary: Hard-deletes a learning row from the table.

nodes.name: ConsolidationRunRecord
nodes.summary: Full record of a consolidation run's scope, account, trigger, mode, counts, error, and timing, written to the consolidation_runs ledger.

nodes.name: scope_for_agent
nodes.summary: Maps an agent_id to its memory scope string used to partition learnings in the shared table.

nodes.name: enforce_caps
nodes.summary: Truncates a learning's text to stay within prompt-injection length/line caps.

nodes.name: format_learnings_for_prompt
nodes.summary: Renders a ranked list of learnings into the markdown block injected into the agent system prompt, applying freshness/reinforcement badges and caps.

nodes.name: learning_prompt_revision
nodes.summary: Computes a revision/version marker for a scope's learnings prompt block so callers can detect when it changes.

nodes.name: inject_learnings_into_prompt
nodes.summary: Main entry point that embeds the query, ranks/searches active learnings, and formats them into the prompt section injected for a turn.

nodes.name: schedule_touch_recall
nodes.summary: Schedules a background, non-blocking touch_recall update for the set of learning IDs that were just surfaced.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the Skills Hub (marketplace) integration: declares the http/types (private) and browse/cache/detail/install/search/update (public, Tauri-reachable) submodules.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that queries the Skills Hub search API, mapping raw results into HubSkillResult entries and layering in local install/update status.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Wire types shared across every Skills Hub endpoint: search/detail results, stats, owner info, install results, snapshot file payloads, and update-availability info.

nodes.name: update.rs
nodes.summary: Checks installed skills against Skills Hub for newer versions and exposes the Tauri command that re-installs (updates) a skill snapshot in place.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level barrel for the agent skills system, declaring the builtin, loader, market, and prefetch submodules that together handle skill discovery, loading, marketplace installation, and prompt prefetch.

nodes.name: dispatch.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the GatewayInboundHandler trait: routes inbound channel messages to the singleton-per-chat OS session, minting/rebinding session IDs, prepending idle-reset notices, and dispatching to the session runtime with reinjection support.
nodes.languageNotes: Split out of a single channel_handler.rs (Apr 2026) so the dispatch flow reads top-to-bottom without interleaving slash-command and lifecycle code.

nodes.name: idle_reset.rs
nodes.summary: Detects whether a channel-bound session's subagents are still active and, if the session has gone idle long enough, archives it and queues a user-facing reset notice for the next outbound message.

nodes.name: skills_hub_search
nodes.summary: Tauri command that queries the Skills Hub search API for a text query, mapping results to HubSkillResult and annotating install/update status against the local skill set.

nodes.name: HubSkillResult
nodes.summary: Search-result shape for a single Skills Hub listing: slug, name, description, timestamps, source, id, and install count.

nodes.name: HubSkillStats
nodes.summary: Popularity/engagement stats for a Skills Hub listing: comments, downloads, install counts, stars, and version count.

nodes.name: HubSkillOwner
nodes.summary: Author identity for a Skills Hub listing: handle, display name, and avatar image.

nodes.name: HubSkillDetail
nodes.summary: Full detail payload for a Skills Hub listing, combining identity, stats, owner, changelog, raw SKILL.md content, and a snapshot hash for update comparison.

nodes.name: SkillUpdateInfo
nodes.summary: Update-availability record comparing an installed skill's version against the latest Skills Hub version, with changelog text.

nodes.name: skills_check_updates
nodes.summary: Tauri command that compares every installed skill's recorded version against Skills Hub and returns the set with a newer version available.

nodes.name: skills_hub_update
nodes.summary: Tauri command that re-downloads and re-installs a skill snapshot in place to apply an available update.

nodes.name: resolve_gateway_model_and_account
nodes.summary: Resolves the (account_id, model) pair for a channel-launched session, preferring explicit gateway integration config over the globally active account (model never falls back).

nodes.name: handle_message
nodes.summary: GatewayInboundHandler's core entry point: resolves the target OS session for an inbound channel message, handles idle-reset and slash commands, and dispatches the remaining content to the session runtime.

nodes.name: derive_os_session_id
nodes.summary: Derives the deterministic OS session id for a (channel, chat_id) pair, including version suffixing.

nodes.name: ensure_os_session_registered
nodes.summary: Ensures an OS session id is registered in the app's session table before messages are routed to it.

nodes.name: dispatch_to_session
nodes.summary: Delivers an inbound message's content to the resolved session, handling reinjection into an active turn versus starting a new turn, and channel config lookups.

nodes.name: prepend_reset_notice
nodes.summary: Prepends a queued idle-reset notice to the next outbound message for a chat, if one was set.

nodes.name: push_debug_outbound
nodes.summary: Debug-only helper that mirrors an outbound message onto the debug event stream.

nodes.name: build_inbound_deps
nodes.summary: Assembles the InboundProcessorDeps bundle (question manager, permission manager, app handle) used to construct the GatewayInboundHandler.

nodes.name: GatewayInboundHandler
nodes.summary: Trait implementation wiring inbound channel messages to the app's session runtime, question manager, and permission manager.

nodes.name: has_active_processes
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session is mid-turn or has active child (subagent) sessions; returns true (conservatively skipping idle-reset) on a DB error.

nodes.name: perform_idle_reset
nodes.summary: Archives an idle session and mints a fresh session for the next inbound message on that chat, queuing a user-facing reset notice.

nodes.name: skill_env_storage.rs
nodes.summary: Persists and loads user-supplied environment variables required by skills (e.g. API keys) to a JSON file, and applies them to the process environment on load.

nodes.name: source_dirs.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves extra skill source directories and lazily unpacks the bundled ai-research-skills archive into a well-known directory on first use.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared data types for the skills system: SkillInfo (the full per-skill descriptor surfaced to the frontend), SkillListingEntry, SkillMetadata (parsed frontmatter), and the DescriptionQuality classification enum.

nodes.name: browse.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the Skills Hub marketplace with no search query, delegating to the same search endpoint used by skills_hub_search.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Reads and writes a per-skill on-disk JSON cache of Skills Hub detail responses so repeated detail lookups avoid a network round trip.

nodes.name: detail.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches full detail (stats, owner, changelog, SKILL.md content) for a single Skills Hub listing by slug.

nodes.name: http.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the shared reqwest HTTP client and holds the skills.sh base URL constants used by every Skills Hub endpoint.

nodes.name: install.rs
nodes.summary: Fetches a skill snapshot from Skills Hub, safely extracts its files under the target skill directory (guarding against path traversal), and exposes the install/uninstall Tauri commands plus frontmatter-scalar extraction helpers used to build the post-install detail response.

nodes.name: load_skill_env
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted skill-environment JSON file from disk, returning an empty map if it doesn't exist yet.

nodes.name: load_and_apply_skill_env
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted skill environment variables and applies each one to the current process environment.

nodes.name: skill_env_save
nodes.summary: Tauri command that persists a full replacement set of skill environment variables to disk and re-applies them to the process.

nodes.name: source_dir_path
nodes.summary: Resolves an ExtraSourceDir enum value to its concrete on-disk path.

nodes.name: ensure_source_dirs
nodes.summary: Ensures each requested extra source directory exists on disk, unpacking bundled archives as needed.

nodes.name: ensure_ai_research_skills
nodes.summary: Lazily unpacks the bundled ai-research-skills archive into its target directory the first time it's requested, skipping if already present.

nodes.name: unpack_ai_research_archive
nodes.summary: Extracts the embedded ai-research-skills archive bytes into a destination directory.

nodes.name: DescriptionQuality
nodes.summary: Classification of a skill's frontmatter description quality (Good/Short/Missing), used to decide whether to substitute a placeholder in listings.

nodes.name: SkillInfo
nodes.summary: Full per-skill descriptor surfaced to the frontend: identity, source, availability/enabled flags, requirement checks, description quality, version/license/compatibility metadata, token estimates, and bundled file list.

nodes.name: SkillListingEntry
nodes.summary: Lightweight entry (name, source, description, availability) used to render the discovery-time skill listing without loading full content.

nodes.name: SkillMetadata
nodes.summary: Parsed SKILL.md frontmatter: name, description, always flag, version/license/compatibility, required bins/env vars, and agent include/exclude lists.

nodes.name: skills_hub_detail_cache_read
nodes.summary: Reads a cached Skills Hub detail response for a skill name from disk, returning None on missing/corrupt cache.

nodes.name: skills_hub_detail_cache_write
nodes.summary: Writes a Skills Hub detail response to the on-disk per-skill cache file.

nodes.name: skills_hub_detail
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches full detail for a Skills Hub listing by slug via HTTP.

nodes.name: build_http_client
nodes.summary: Constructs the shared reqwest client used for all Skills Hub HTTP requests, with timeout configuration.

nodes.name: split_skills_sh_slug
nodes.summary: Splits a skills.sh slug into its owner and skill-name components.

nodes.name: snapshot_skill_md
nodes.summary: Extracts the SKILL.md file content from a downloaded skill snapshot's file list.

nodes.name: fetch_skill_snapshot
nodes.summary: Downloads a skill's file snapshot (all bundled files + hash) from Skills Hub over HTTP.

nodes.name: safe_join_skill_file
nodes.summary: Joins a snapshot file's relative path onto the target skill directory, rejecting paths that would escape it.

nodes.name: install_skill_snapshot
nodes.summary: Writes every file in a downloaded skill snapshot to disk under the skill directory, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: skills_hub_install
nodes.summary: Tauri command that downloads and installs a skill from Skills Hub by slug into the appropriate local skill directory.

nodes.name: build_detail_from_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds a HubSkillDetail response object from a slug and its downloaded snapshot when the full detail endpoint isn't available.

nodes.name: skills_hub_uninstall
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes an installed skill's directory from disk.

nodes.name: extract_frontmatter_scalar
nodes.summary: Extracts a single scalar YAML frontmatter field's value from raw SKILL.md content by key.

nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the channel inbound/outbound processors and hydrates the binding cache from SQLite, plus the Tauri commands the frontend uses to toggle a channel on/off and change the default channel-launch model.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the channel inbound handler: routes external channel messages to the OS singleton-per-chat session, re-exporting the lifecycle Tauri commands and their generated __cmd__ siblings.
nodes.languageNotes: Doc comment records an Apr-2026 design pivot away from a pure LLM router to a conversation-first OS agent that delegates coding work via a unified subagent tool.

nodes.name: slash.rs
nodes.summary: Handles explicit gateway slash commands (/help, /new, /status, /model, /compact) for channel-bound chats, including model-alias resolution against the account's available models.

nodes.name: desktop.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands and config model for desktop automation safety settings (hide-before-action, anti-detection, escape-abort) plus native macOS Accessibility/ScreenCaptureKit permission checking and request flows.

nodes.name: channel.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands for channel-bound agent messaging: routes a user-submitted channel message into the session runtime with attached repo/branch/image context, probes channel credentials, and relays IDE action-bridge results.

nodes.name: ensure_gateway_infra
nodes.summary: Starts the channel inbound/outbound processors and hydrates the channel-binding cache from SQLite; idempotent no-op if already running.

nodes.name: restore_enabled_channels
nodes.summary: Restores previously enabled channel bindings from persistence on app startup.

nodes.name: agent_toggle_channel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that enables or disables a channel integration for an account.

nodes.name: init_channel_session
nodes.summary: Initializes a new channel-bound session with the given account and optional model override.

nodes.name: agent_set_gateway_model
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the default model used for new channel-launched sessions on an account.

nodes.name: handle_command
nodes.summary: Dispatches a parsed gateway slash command (/help, /new, /status, /model, /compact) to its handler and writes an acknowledgment to the outbound bus.

nodes.name: handle_model_command
nodes.summary: Handles /model: resolves the requested model alias against the account's available models and updates the session/channel binding.

nodes.name: resolve_model_target
nodes.summary: Resolves a user-supplied model alias string to a canonical model id for the given account.

nodes.name: best_candidate_for_alias
nodes.summary: Picks the best-matching model candidate for an alias from a list, preferring exact canonical-target matches.

nodes.name: normalize_model_key

nodes.name: OpenAiChatWirePolicy

nodes.name: OpenAiCapabilityCacheKey

nodes.name: streaming_events.rs

nodes.name: types.rs

nodes.name: safe_truncate.rs

nodes.name: traits.rs

nodes.name: wire_sanitize.rs

nodes.name: ingest_output_item

nodes.name: take_tool_call

nodes.name: from_wire
nodes.summary: Maps a raw Responses API SSE `type` string into the internal ResponseStreamEventKind enum.

nodes.name: bounded_event_sample
nodes.summary: Produces a length-bounded debug sample string of an SSE event for logging without flooding logs with large payloads.

nodes.name: ResponsesStreamOutput
nodes.summary: Enum of normalized stream outputs the Responses SSE normalizer can produce: block boundaries, text/reasoning deltas, tool-call lifecycle events, completion, error, and unknown frames.

nodes.name: ResponsesStreamNormalizer
nodes.summary: Stateful normalizer that ingests raw Responses API SSE events and emits a uniform ResponsesStreamOutput stream, tracking pending tool calls and item/call id mappings across events.

nodes.name: ResponseStreamEventKind

nodes.name: display_message
nodes.summary: Returns the best available human-readable message for a ResponsesError, for display or logging.

nodes.name: into_provider_error
nodes.summary: Converts a ResponsesError into the crate's internal ProviderError enum, classifying it (auth, rate-limit, etc.) in the process.

nodes.name: classify_responses_error_message
nodes.summary: Classifies a Responses API error message string into a coarse error category used to select the right ProviderError variant.

nodes.name: enforce_strict_schema
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites a JSON schema to satisfy the Responses API's strict-mode requirements (e.g. `additionalProperties: false`, all properties required).

nodes.name: make_schema_nullable
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites a JSON schema so its properties accept null, used when downgrading a strict schema to accept optional fields.

nodes.name: extract_account_id_from_id_token

nodes.name: ResponsesRequest
nodes.summary: Wire-format request body struct for the OpenAI Responses API: model, input items, instructions, tools, tool_choice, max_output_tokens, temperature, reasoning, store, and stream flags.

nodes.name: ResponsesError
nodes.summary: Wire-format struct for a Responses API error object (message, code, error_type, param) with helpers to produce a display message and classify it as an auth error or ProviderError.

nodes.name: StreamEvent
nodes.summary: Wire-format struct for a single raw Responses API SSE event, carrying whichever subset of type/response/code/message/param/error/delta/call_id/item_id/item fields that event kind populates.

nodes.name: primary_text
nodes.summary: Returns the primary visible text content of an LLMResponse, excluding reasoning content.

nodes.name: iter_blocks
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator over an LLMResponse's ordered AssistantBlocks (text, reasoning, tool call).

nodes.name: text
nodes.summary: Convenience constructor building a StreamDelta that carries only visible text content, with no reasoning, tool-call delta, or finish reason set.

nodes.name: into_provider_stream_event

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Implements Display for ProviderError, formatting each error variant into a human-readable message.

nodes.name: LLMResponse
nodes.summary: The unified response shape every provider maps its native response into: aggregate content, tool calls, finish reason, usage, reasoning content, and ordered content blocks.

nodes.name: ProviderStreamEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of normalized streaming lifecycle events (message delta, thinking delta, tool-call delta/start/ready, flush segment, complete, unknown frame) consumed by the turn executor.

nodes.name: SideQueryExecution

nodes.name: LLMProvider

nodes.name: ProviderError
nodes.summary: Enum of all error conditions a provider can surface (request failure, parse error, auth error, usage limit, rate limited, overloaded, model not found, context too long, media too large, cancelled, other), implementing Display for uniform error messages.

nodes.name: StreamErrorKind
nodes.summary: Enum classifying streaming failures into idle-timeout, overloaded, provider-error, connection-error, or unknown, used by ReliableProvider to decide retry behavior.

nodes.name: StreamDelta
nodes.summary: The unified streaming delta shape every provider emits per SSE chunk: content, reasoning, tool-call delta, finish reason, and usage.

nodes.name: ProviderConfig
nodes.summary: Struct carrying the credentials and connection settings (api_key, api_base, extra_headers, is_azure) needed to construct any provider client.

nodes.name: strip_tool_schema_cache_scopes

nodes.name: coalesce_system_messages_to_front

nodes.name: sanitize_deepseek_messages

nodes.name: sanitize_message
nodes.summary: Applies cache-metadata stripping and content normalization to a single outgoing message.

nodes.name: flatten_text_content
nodes.summary: Flattens a message's rich content-block array down to a single plain-text string, for providers that reject block-array content.

nodes.name: flatten_text_content_with_image_placeholders
nodes.summary: Flattens rich content to plain text like flatten_text_content, but replaces image blocks with a textual placeholder instead of dropping them silently.

nodes.name: strip_content_cache_metadata
nodes.summary: Removes internal prompt-cache scope metadata from a message's content blocks before sending it over the wire.

nodes.name: client.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP client for the OpenAI Responses API (`/v1/responses`): builds authenticated requests and Responses-shaped request bodies, and parses non-2xx responses into ProviderError.

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: streaming.rs

nodes.name: reliable.rs
nodes.summary: LLMProvider wrapper that adds retry with exponential backoff, rate-limit cooldown tracking, and multi-provider fallback chains around any wrapped LLMProvider implementation, classifying errors to decide whether to retry, fail fast, or fall through to the next provider.

nodes.name: converter.rs
nodes.summary: Converts generic internal chat messages and tool schemas into the OpenAI Responses API wire format, including image follow-up messages and tool_choice translation, shared by both the public OpenAI Responses client and the Codex native client.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregator module for types and utilities shared by the OpenAI Responses API client and the Codex native client; re-exports message conversion, response parsing, and stream normalization APIs.

nodes.name: parser.rs
nodes.summary: Parses a completed Responses API response body into the internal LLMResponse shape, extracting reasoning summaries, tool calls, and finish reason.

nodes.name: build_request
nodes.summary: Builds an authenticated reqwest RequestBuilder for the given URL and JSON request body, attaching the bearer token and standard headers.

nodes.name: build_responses_request
nodes.summary: Builds a ResponsesRequest wire body from internal messages, tools, model, max_tokens, and streaming flag, ready to send to the Responses endpoint.

nodes.name: parse_error
nodes.summary: Parses a non-2xx Responses API HTTP response into a typed ProviderError, incorporating retry-after and structured error fields when present.

nodes.name: OpenAIResponsesClient
nodes.summary: HTTP client struct for the public OpenAI Responses API holding the underlying reqwest client, provider config, and default model.

nodes.name: direct_openai_model_prefers_responses
nodes.summary: Direct-public-OpenAI startup hint that returns true for known GPT-5.4+ model name patterns, used only after the caller has confirmed the request targets OpenAI's public API rather than a custom base URL or aggregator.

nodes.name: extract_gpt5_version

nodes.name: chat_streaming

nodes.name: single
nodes.summary: Wraps a single LLMProvider in a ReliableProvider with the given max-retries and base-backoff configuration, with no fallback chain.

nodes.name: with_fallbacks
nodes.summary: Wraps an ordered list of LLMProvider implementations in a ReliableProvider so that exhausting retries on one provider falls through to the next.

nodes.name: broadcast_retry
nodes.summary: Emits a structured log/telemetry event describing a retry attempt (provider, error, attempt number, backoff) for observability.

nodes.name: error_kind
nodes.summary: Classifies a ProviderError into a coarse error-kind label used to decide retry/fallback/fail-fast behavior.

nodes.name: is_non_retryable
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given ProviderError should never be retried (e.g. auth errors, context-too-long) and should instead fail immediately or fall through to the next provider.

nodes.name: server_retry_directive
nodes.summary: Extracts a server-supplied retry directive (e.g. explicit Retry-After) from a ProviderError, when the provider communicated one.

nodes.name: retry_after_ms
nodes.summary: Computes the retry delay in milliseconds implied by a ProviderError, combining server directives with default backoff bounds.

nodes.name: wait_for_rate_limit_cooldown
nodes.summary: Awaits any active rate-limit cooldown window recorded for a given provider/model pair before allowing a new request to proceed.

nodes.name: record_rate_limit_cooldown
nodes.summary: Records a rate-limit cooldown window for a given provider/model pair so subsequent requests wait it out before retrying.

nodes.name: chat

nodes.name: chat_with_options
nodes.summary: Core retry/fallback loop for non-streaming chat requests: iterates the provider chain, retries transient failures with backoff and rate-limit cooldown awareness, and falls through to the next provider when one is exhausted.

nodes.name: chat_streaming

nodes.name: ReliableProvider

nodes.name: normalize_input_content_part

nodes.name: build_image_followup

nodes.name: convert_tools

nodes.name: convert_tools_with_choice

nodes.name: reasoning_summary_text_from_value

nodes.name: hashing.rs
nodes.summary: Computes a normalized SHA-256 hash of a code node's content (whitespace-collapsed per line) used to detect unchanged provenance entries.

nodes.name: provenance.rs
nodes.summary: Records a node_provenance row for an AI-session edit, hashing the touched content and attributing any tree-sitter symbols whose line range overlaps the edit.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Creates the node_provenance and commit_lineage SQLite tables (with supporting indexes) used by the lineage-tracking subsystem.

nodes.name: diff_stats.rs
nodes.summary: Computes added/removed/renamed file statistics between a work item's branch and its base branch by parsing `git diff --numstat` output.

nodes.name: proof_of_work.rs
nodes.summary: Small mutator helpers that record an agent session's branch, accumulated cost/tokens, PR link, review outcome, diff stats, and review feedback onto a work item's proof-of-work frontmatter.

nodes.name: get_provenance_session_ids
nodes.summary: Queries distinct session_id values from node_provenance, returning every chat session that has recorded lineage.

nodes.name: get_session_impact
nodes.summary: Aggregates a session's touched files, created functions, influenced commits, total attributed lines, and first/last timestamps into a SessionImpact summary.

nodes.name: SessionImpact
nodes.summary: Summary record of a chat session's impact: files touched, functions created, commits influenced, total lines attributed, and edit/commit timestamps. Serialized to the frontend session-impact view.

nodes.name: FunctionEntry
nodes.summary: Row shape for a function-level provenance entry: file, name, node type, and line range.

nodes.name: match_commit
nodes.summary: Fetches a commit's diff via git_bridge, then for each changed line range finds overlapping node_provenance entries and inserts commit_lineage rows linking the commit to the provenance that produced those lines.

nodes.name: process_events
nodes.summary: Iterates a batch of tool-call events for a session, dispatching each edit event to process_single_event.

nodes.name: process_single_event
nodes.summary: Handles a single file-edit tool-call event: extracts the target file path from the event args, resolves the touched line range, and records provenance for it.

nodes.name: resolve_line_range
nodes.summary: Determines the start/end line range touched by an edit event, dispatching to resolve_replace_range or resolve_append_range depending on which args fields are present.

nodes.name: resolve_replace_range
nodes.summary: Computes the line range affected by an old_string/new_string replace edit by locating the old content's byte offset in the current file and counting lines.

nodes.name: resolve_append_range
nodes.summary: Computes the line range affected by an append-style edit based on the existing file's line count and the appended content's line count.

nodes.name: process_patch_event
nodes.summary: Parses an apply_patch-style multi-file patch, extracting per-file added/updated hunks and recording provenance for each touched file/range.

nodes.name: parse_hunk_header
nodes.summary: Parses a unified-diff `@@ -a,b +c,d @@` hunk header into a start/count line range.

nodes.name: count_patch_content_lines
nodes.summary: Counts the content lines belonging to a given target file within an apply_patch-style patch block.

nodes.name: get_commit_diff
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered commit-diff implementation (injected by the git integration layer) to fetch a LineageCommitDiff for a commit SHA, erroring if no implementation was registered.

nodes.name: LineageHunk
nodes.summary: A single diff hunk's new-side start line and line count.

nodes.name: LineageFileDiff
nodes.summary: Per-file diff entry: file path, binary flag, and its hunks.

nodes.name: LineageCommitDiff
nodes.summary: A full commit diff as a list of per-file diffs.

nodes.name: compute_node_hash
nodes.summary: Hashes code content (start_line..end_line) with SHA-256 after collapsing per-line whitespace, so formatting-only changes don't produce a new hash.

nodes.name: record_provenance
nodes.summary: Reads the edited file, clamps the given line range to its length, hashes the content, finds tree-sitter symbols overlapping the range, and inserts a node_provenance row (plus one row per overlapping symbol).
