nodes.summary: Merkle tree data structure and construction: recursively hashes repository files with blake3 in parallel (via rayon and the ignore crate) to build a directory-hash tree used for fast incremental change detection.

nodes.name: LocalImport
nodes.summary: Represents an import binding (source range) recorded at a use/import site during lexical scope-graph construction, with a byte-slice accessor for its display name.

nodes.name: ResolutionMethod
nodes.summary: Enum selecting the scope-resolution strategy for a language (currently a single generic Tree-sitter-query-driven method) and dispatching to build a ScopeGraph.

nodes.name: NodeKind
nodes.summary: Enum of scope-graph node kinds (scope, definition, hoisted/global definition, import, reference), each carrying its own source text range.

nodes.name: EdgeKind
nodes.summary: Enum of scope-graph edge kinds (e.g. ScopeToScope, DefToScope) that classify the relationship between two nodes in the lexical scope graph.

nodes.name: ScopeGraph
nodes.summary: Directed graph of a file's lexical scopes, definitions, imports, and references built on petgraph, exposing lookups for go-to-definition, find-references, symbol listing, and node/position queries.

nodes.name: scope_res_generic
nodes.summary: Generic Tree-sitter scope-resolution algorithm: walks the syntax tree driven by a language's scope query, populating the ScopeGraph's scopes, definitions, hoisted/global defs, imports, and references in a single pass.

nodes.name: Reference
nodes.summary: Represents a symbol reference site (source range plus optional resolved symbol id) recorded in the lexical scope graph.

nodes.name: LocalScope
nodes.summary: Represents a lexical scope as a source text range in the scope graph.

nodes.name: ScopeStack
nodes.summary: Iterator that walks up the chain of parent scopes from a starting scope-graph node, following ScopeToScope edges, used to resolve names against enclosing lexical scopes.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Iterator::next implementation for ScopeStack: follows the current scope's outgoing ScopeToScope edge to its parent scope, ending when no parent remains.

nodes.name: Point
nodes.summary: Represents a byte/line/column position in source text, ordered by byte offset; constructed directly or derived from a byte offset plus a per-line end-index table via from_byte.

nodes.name: TextRange
nodes.summary: Represents a start/end Point span in source text with containment and size helpers, plus conversions to/from Tree-sitter's Range and std::ops::Range; the core position type used across search matches, symbols, and scope-graph nodes.

nodes.name: merkle_build_tree
nodes.summary: Tauri command that builds a fresh Merkle tree for a repository and persists it as the baseline snapshot for future change detection.

nodes.name: merkle_diff_since_snapshot
nodes.summary: Tauri command that builds the current Merkle tree, diffs it against the last saved snapshot to compute added/modified/deleted files, then saves the new tree as the latest snapshot.

nodes.name: merkle_get_stats
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns file-count and last-built-at stats for a repository's saved Merkle snapshot, without rebuilding the tree.

nodes.name: diff_trees
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the Merkle diff algorithm: compares an old and new Merkle tree and returns the list of changed files.

nodes.name: diff_nodes
nodes.summary: Recursively compares two Merkle tree nodes, short-circuiting on equal hashes and recursing into changed directories or reporting added/modified/deleted files.

nodes.name: collect_all_files
nodes.summary: Recursively collects every file under a Merkle tree node, tagging each with the given change type; used to report a whole added or deleted subtree.

nodes.name: save_snapshot
nodes.summary: Serializes a Merkle tree to JSON and writes it to the per-repo snapshot file under the app's merkle-snapshot directory, creating the directory if needed.

nodes.name: load_snapshot
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes a repository's saved Merkle tree snapshot from disk, returning None if no snapshot exists yet.

nodes.name: MerkleNode
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a File (hash+size) or a Directory (hash+child nodes) in the Merkle tree, with a hash() accessor common to both variants.

nodes.name: MerkleTree
nodes.summary: Top-level Merkle tree over a repository's files, built via gitignore-aware traversal and parallel blake3 hashing, with an incremental update_files method for re-hashing only changed paths.

nodes.name: insert_file_node

nodes.name: is_indexable_extension
nodes.summary: Returns whether a file extension belongs to the allow-list of source/asset types indexed by the Merkle tree (code, markup, config, etc.).

nodes.name: rust.rs

nodes.name: snakeToCamel

nodes.name: subagentHandlers.ts

nodes.name: handleCodingSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Routes a spawned coding-session's WS events (todos, complete, error) back onto the parent tool_call for the OS Agent's legacy coding-session bridge.

nodes.name: toolUsageCache.ts
nodes.summary: Session-scoped LRU cache and mapping utilities for tool-usage and LLM-usage telemetry, joining Rust-reported usage spans onto EventStore events by call id / turn id for cost and token display.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a small hand-rolled LRU (Map insertion-order eviction) keyed by sessionId to bound memory for usage telemetry across many open sessions.

nodes.name: touchSessionCache
nodes.summary: Inserts or refreshes a session's usage-by-call-id map in the LRU cache, evicting the oldest entry when the cache exceeds its size bound.

nodes.name: buildRelatedCacheMap
nodes.summary: Builds a map from tool_call_id to the set of related tool_call_ids declared in each usage span's relatedToolCallIds field.

nodes.name: toMetadata
nodes.summary: Converts a raw tool-usage attribution record plus its related-call cache entry into the normalized usage metadata shape stored per call id.

nodes.name: buildUsageMap
nodes.summary: Builds the full tool_call_id-to-usage-metadata map for a session from raw usage records and LLM usage spans, propagating usage onto related calls.

nodes.name: buildLlmUsageByTurnMap
nodes.summary: Builds a map from turn id to aggregated LLM token-usage info from the session's raw LLM usage spans.

nodes.name: withToolUsageArgs
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of a tool-call args object with the given tool-usage metadata merged in.

nodes.name: withLlmUsageArgs
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of an event's args object with the given LLM token-usage info merged in.

nodes.name: selectLlmUsageTargetEvents
nodes.summary: Selects, per turn, the single assistant-message or thinking event that should receive the turn's aggregated LLM usage annotation.

nodes.name: applyLlmUsageToEvents
nodes.summary: Applies per-turn LLM usage info onto the appropriate assistant/thinking events in an event list, returning a new list with usage args merged in.

nodes.name: applyToolUsageToEvents
nodes.summary: Applies per-call-id tool-usage metadata onto matching tool events in an event list, returning a new list with usage args merged in.

nodes.name: loadUsageTelemetry
nodes.summary: Fetches tool-usage attributions and LLM-usage spans for a session from the Rust bridge, builds the usage maps, and caches them.

nodes.name: loadAndCacheToolUsage
nodes.summary: Public entry point that loads and caches usage telemetry for a session, ignoring the return value.

nodes.name: getCachedToolUsage
nodes.summary: Returns the cached usage-by-call-id map for a session, if present, refreshing its LRU recency.

nodes.name: refreshCursorIdeSnapshotLastUpdatedAt

nodes.name: getCursorIdeReloadState

nodes.name: ensureCursorIdeEventsInStore

nodes.name: scheduleCursorIdeForcedReload

nodes.name: loadCursorIdeEventsIntoStore

nodes.name: actionsUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions supporting the session action atoms: caching in-flight tool "running args", applying them onto matching events, and resetting per-session UI/replay state on session switch or navigation.

nodes.name: resetRunningArgsCache
nodes.summary: Clears the module-level cache tracking in-flight tool call arguments.

nodes.name: extendRunningArgsCache
nodes.summary: Scans events for running tool calls and records their latest args into the running-args cache.

nodes.name: applyRunningArgs
nodes.summary: Applies cached running args onto matching target events so partial/streamed tool args stay visible.

nodes.name: resetSessionUIState
nodes.summary: Resets a session's replay/UI-related atoms (current event, replay bar, filters) when the session changes.

nodes.name: navigateToEventAndUpdateBar
nodes.summary: Navigates the replay cursor to a specific event and synchronizes the replay bar value accordingly.

nodes.name: replay.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atoms controlling replay/scrub state (current event id/index, replay bar value, time range, replay mode) plus a session-storage-backed atom adapter for persisting replay mode across reloads.

nodes.name: createSessionStorageAdapter
nodes.summary: Builds a Jotai storage adapter backed by sessionStorage with a safe JSON parse/stringify fallback to a default value.

nodes.name: streamingDeltaBuffer.ts
nodes.summary: Batches and rate-limits incoming streaming text deltas per session with an animation-frame-aligned flush loop, avoiding excessive re-renders while assistant text streams in.

nodes.name: flushStreamingDeltas
nodes.summary: Flushes all buffered per-session streaming delta content into the corresponding atoms and clears the buffer.

nodes.name: bufferStreamingDelta
nodes.summary: Appends new streamed text to a session's buffer and schedules a throttled flush.

nodes.name: clearStreamingDelta
nodes.summary: Immediately clears a session's buffered streaming content and cancels its pending flush.

nodes.name: discardStreamingDeltaBuffer
nodes.summary: Drops a session's buffer entirely without flushing it into the atom, used when streaming is aborted.

nodes.name: interactiveTools.ts
nodes.summary: Small registry of tool names considered "interactive" (e.g. ask-user-question, exit-plan-mode) with a helper to detect them after stripping MCP tool-name prefixes.

nodes.name: stripMcpPrefix
nodes.summary: Removes the MCP server prefix from a namespaced tool name to get its base name.

nodes.name: isInteractiveTool
nodes.summary: Checks whether a possibly MCP-prefixed tool name is one of the known interactive tools requiring user input.

nodes.name: runningEventGate.ts
nodes.summary: Classifies the latest turn's activity (shell processes, await-output, interactive tools) to determine whether a turn is still live/blocking, gating when the composer stop button and timeline boundaries may act.

nodes.name: shellProcessStatusFromArgs
nodes.summary: Parses a tool call's raw args JSON to extract the shell process status field, if present.

nodes.name: isLiveRuntimeResourceEvent
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event represents a still-live runtime resource such as a running shell process or active await.

nodes.name: classifyLatestTurnActivity
nodes.summary: Scans the latest turn's events to classify overall activity, including live resources and blocking awaits.

nodes.name: hasLiveRuntimeResourceInLatestTurn
nodes.summary: Reports whether the latest turn has any still-live runtime resource.

nodes.name: hasRunningAwaitWaitForInLatestTurn
nodes.summary: Reports whether the latest turn has a running await_wait_for style blocking call.

nodes.name: isTurnBlockingRuntimeEvent
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event's shell process status should block turn completion.

nodes.name: isComposerStopBlockingEvent
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event should block the composer's stop action from completing immediately.

nodes.name: sessionHasComposerStopBlockingWork
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session currently has work in flight that should block the stop button.

nodes.name: isTimelineBoundaryClosableRuntimeEvent
nodes.summary: Determines whether a live runtime-resource event can be safely closed by a timeline boundary, excluding interactive-tool waits.

nodes.name: schemas.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schemas and thin parsing helpers validating raw session events, specs, and JSON payloads coming from the Rust backend before they enter the frontend event store.

nodes.name: memoryEstimation.ts
nodes.summary: Rough in-memory size estimator for arbitrary JS values, used to report event-store memory stats, walking objects/arrays/Maps/Sets with cycle protection and depth/node-count limits.

nodes.name: estimateObjectBytesInternal
nodes.summary: Recursively walks an object/array/Map/Set estimating its in-memory byte size with cycle detection and node/depth caps.

nodes.name: estimateObjectBytes
nodes.summary: Public entry point that estimates the byte size of an arbitrary value using a fresh traversal state.

nodes.name: snapshotCache.ts
nodes.summary: Session-scoped snapshot cache with an LRU-ish eviction budget, applying delta envelopes onto pending full snapshots and flushing them through a per-session callback when ready.

nodes.name: storeSnapshot
nodes.summary: Stores a full snapshot for a session into the latest/normalized snapshot maps, evicting the oldest sessions when the max-snapshot or event budget is exceeded.

nodes.name: applyDeltaEnvelope
nodes.summary: Applies an incoming delta envelope onto the pending-delta queue for a session, merging with any already-pending delta.

nodes.name: flushPendingDelta
nodes.summary: Materializes a session's pending delta onto its cached snapshot and stores the resulting full snapshot, invoking an eviction callback as needed.

nodes.name: rememberSnapshot
nodes.summary: High-level entry point that records a fresh full snapshot for a session, replacing any pending delta state.

nodes.name: useEventStoreBridge.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that wires a session's event-store snapshot into local component state, handling live subscription, streaming/derived-snapshot merging, and lazy full-snapshot hydration.

nodes.name: applyEventUpserts
nodes.summary: Applies a list of event upserts onto the previous event array/index, inserting new events or replacing existing ones in place.

nodes.name: eventsForIds
nodes.summary: Resolves a list of event ids to their corresponding event objects using an id-to-index map.

nodes.name: useEventStoreBridge
nodes.summary: React hook that subscribes a session to the event store proxy, hydrates the initial/full snapshot, and merges streaming/derived updates into local component state.

nodes.name: planContentPersistence.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves and persists user-edited plan markdown content back into the underlying create_plan tool-call event and cache, matching pending edits to the correct event via plan alias identity.

nodes.name: planDisplayEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Core plan-approval domain logic: identifies create_plan/approval events, computes identity/aliasing across plan revisions, groups and derives which plan event to display, and computes the full plan-approval card view state (visibility, staleness, collapse).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a WeakMap-backed memoization cache keyed on the events array reference to avoid recomputation on unrelated re-renders.

nodes.name: simulatorEventFilters.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the simulator event filter categories and a fallback classifier plus a visibility predicate used by the simulator UI's filter toggles.

nodes.name: simulatorEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Large set of Jotai derived atoms powering the multi-app simulator event timeline: sorted/filtered event lists, current-preview navigation atoms, thread-scoped filtering, and a preview-builder that adapts raw events into simulator-friendly previews.

nodes.name: useReplayState.ts
nodes.summary: React hooks exposing replay bar/time-range state (current event, replay mode, elapsed time) derived from the session atoms, including a helper to compute events-per-second across simulator specs.

nodes.name: useStepState.ts
nodes.summary: Small hook exposing hover/pressed interaction state for the replay stepper's step-forward and step-back controls.

nodes.name: visibilityFilters.ts
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session event should be rendered in the chat view, filtering out empty/whitespace-only tool results and stripping trailing terminal code fences from streaming output.

nodes.name: cacheAdapter.ts
nodes.summary: Thin facade re-exporting the sqliteCache RPC functions under a stable cacheAdapter API surface, decoupling callers from the underlying storage implementation.

nodes.name: waitForSnapshotChange.ts
nodes.summary: Promise-based utility that subscribes to the event store and resolves once a session's snapshot changes according to a caller-supplied predicate, with timeout and AbortSignal support.

nodes.name: resolvePlanMarkdownContent
nodes.summary: Resolves the markdown content to display for a plan event, preferring the caller's in-progress pending edit when it matches the event, otherwise falling back to the event's streamed/final content.

nodes.name: buildPlanContentPatches
nodes.summary: Builds the list of event-id/content patches needed to persist an edited plan, matching the edit against all events that share the same plan aliases.

nodes.name: persistEditedPlanContent
nodes.summary: Orchestrates persisting edited plan markdown: writes it to disk via the io abstraction, computes patches against loaded events, applies them, and updates the cache.

nodes.name: getPlanEventIdentity
nodes.summary: Computes the stable identity (call-id/tool-call-id or a synthesized fallback) used to correlate a create_plan/approval event across streaming, submission, and rehydration.

nodes.name: derivePlanDisplayEvents
nodes.summary: Groups raw session events into plan-approval groups by identity/alias and derives one representative display event per group, memoized against the input events array.

nodes.name: pendingPlanMatchesEvent
nodes.summary: Determines whether an in-progress pending plan edit corresponds to a given plan display event, by comparing their alias sets for overlap.

nodes.name: derivePlanApprovalViewState
nodes.summary: Computes the full view state for a plan-approval UI surface across every plan revision in a session: status, staleness vs sibling revisions, whether to render the current surface, and default collapse behavior.

nodes.name: planEventContentSignature
nodes.summary: Produces a content-based signature string (title, streamed/final content, revision id, status) for a plan event, used to detect meaningful content changes for memoization/equality checks.

nodes.name: getFallbackSimulatorEventFilterCategory
nodes.summary: Classifies a session event into a simulator filter category (e.g. tool call, message, error) when no explicit category has been provided.

nodes.name: buildSimulatorEventPreview
nodes.summary: Builds a lightweight preview projection of a raw session event for simulator timeline rendering, including its resolved filter category.

nodes.name: useReplayState
nodes.summary: React hook exposing full replay controls: current event navigation, replay bar value/time-range, and per-session events-per-second specs, backed by the session's Jotai atoms.

nodes.name: useStepState
nodes.summary: React hook tracking hover/pressed interaction state for the replay stepper's step-forward and step-back buttons.

nodes.name: isVisibleInChat
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session event should be rendered in the chat transcript, filtering out no-op tool results and empty content while allowing thought/observation/result text through.

nodes.name: waitForSnapshotChange
nodes.summary: Subscribes to store snapshot updates and resolves a promise once a caller-supplied predicate matches the latest snapshot, with timeout and AbortSignal cancellation support.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared serializable type definitions for the browser crate -- console/network log entries, cookie info, element geometry, computed styles, and DOM tree nodes -- used across the logging, cookies, and DOM-editor command modules.

nodes.name: ConsoleLogEntry
nodes.summary: Serializable console log entry (level, message, timestamp, URL, stack) captured from a webview by the console-capture script.

nodes.name: NetworkLogEntry
nodes.summary: Serializable network request log entry (id, method, URL, status, timing, size) captured from a webview by the network-capture script.

nodes.name: CookieInfo
nodes.summary: Serializable cookie record (name, value, domain, path, flags, expiry) returned by the native cookie-access commands.

nodes.name: ElementRect
nodes.summary: Serializable bounding rectangle (x, y, width, height) for a DOM element.

nodes.name: ElementComputedStyle
nodes.summary: Serializable subset of computed CSS style properties for a DOM element.

nodes.name: SimpleSourceLocation
nodes.summary: Serializable minimal source-file/line pointer used for source mapping DOM elements back to code.

nodes.name: ComponentStackEntry
nodes.summary: Serializable entry in a React component stack trace, pairing a component name with its source location.

nodes.name: SourceLocation
nodes.summary: Serializable full source-mapping payload (file, line, column, component name/stack, search hint) for a DOM element.

nodes.name: ElementInfo
nodes.summary: Serializable full description of a DOM element (tag, selector, attributes, text, rect, computed style, xpath, source location) used by the inspector.

nodes.name: DOMTreeNode
nodes.summary: Serializable recursive DOM tree node (tag, id, class, xpath, rect, children) used to render the inspector's element tree.

nodes.name: FullComputedStyles
nodes.summary: Serializable full set of computed CSS style properties (box model, flex/grid, typography, color, transform) for a DOM element.

nodes.name: internal_browser_state.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks which inline webview is the current 'active' internal browser target, bridging the frontend-owned webview lifecycle to Rust so agent tools can resolve the active browser without guessing from a generic session id.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the `browser` crate that declares and re-exports all browser/webview submodules (windows, inline, cookies, logging, DOM editing, scripts, types) as the crate's public API.

nodes.name: logging.rs
nodes.summary: Captures console and network logs from inline webviews and implements element-inspection tooling (highlight, select, computed styles, DOM tree) backed by platform-specific JavaScript evaluation on WKWebView/WebView2.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides three cfg-gated implementations of `eval_js_with_result` (macOS via WKWebView, Windows via WebView2, and a not-yet-implemented fallback for other platforms) behind a single shared signature.

nodes.name: screenshot_store.rs
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility re-export of `ScreenshotEntry`/`ScreenshotStore`, which now live in the `shared_state` crate to avoid a circular dependency between it and the browser crate.

nodes.name: validate_active_state
nodes.summary: Validates that a recorded active internal browser state is still consistent (matching label/session id) before it is returned to callers.

nodes.name: should_clear
nodes.summary: Determines whether the currently recorded active internal browser state should be cleared given a label, session id, and timestamp.

nodes.name: ActiveInternalBrowserState
nodes.summary: Serializable record of the currently active internal browser webview (session id, label, URL, visibility, timestamp).

nodes.name: InternalBrowserTargetInfo
nodes.summary: Serializable descriptor for a single internal browser webview target, including whether it is currently active.

nodes.name: InternalBrowserTargetList
nodes.summary: Serializable list of all internal browser webview targets plus the active one.

nodes.name: set_active_internal_browser_state
nodes.summary: Records which inline webview is the current active internal browser target.

nodes.name: clear_active_internal_browser_state
nodes.summary: Clears the recorded active internal browser target if the provided label/session id/timestamp match the current state.

nodes.name: get_active_internal_browser_state
nodes.summary: Returns the currently recorded active internal browser target state, if any.

nodes.name: list_internal_browser_targets
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists all known internal browser webview targets and which one is currently active.

nodes.name: eval_js_with_result
nodes.summary: macOS implementation that evaluates JavaScript in a WKWebView via Objective-C `evaluateJavaScript:completionHandler:` and returns the result string, falling back to a default on error or timeout.

nodes.name: normalize_webview2_eval_result
nodes.summary: Normalizes the raw JSON-ish string returned by WebView2's ExecuteScript into a plain string result.

nodes.name: eval_js_with_result
nodes.summary: Windows implementation that evaluates JavaScript in a WebView2 control via `ExecuteScript` and normalizes the completion-handler result, falling back to a default on error or timeout.

nodes.name: eval_js_with_result
nodes.summary: Fallback implementation for platforms other than macOS/Windows that returns the default value since JavaScript-eval results are not yet retrievable there.

nodes.name: get_webview_console_logs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that retrieves buffered console log entries captured from an inline webview by the injected console-capture script.

nodes.name: get_webview_network_logs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that retrieves buffered network request log entries captured from an inline webview.

nodes.name: toggle_webview_inspect_mode
nodes.summary: Tauri command that toggles the DevTools-like element inspection mode on or off for a webview.

nodes.name: enable_webview_inspect_mode
nodes.summary: Tauri command that enables element inspection mode on a webview.

nodes.name: disable_webview_inspect_mode
nodes.summary: Tauri command that disables element inspection mode on a webview.

nodes.name: get_selected_element_info
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns detailed info (rect, styles, attributes, source location) for the currently inspector-selected DOM element.

nodes.name: clear_element_selection
nodes.summary: Tauri command that clears the current inspector element selection in a webview.

nodes.name: open_webview_devtools
nodes.summary: Tauri command that opens the native browser DevTools panel for a webview.

nodes.name: close_webview_devtools
nodes.summary: Tauri command that closes the native browser DevTools panel for a webview.

nodes.name: is_webview_devtools_open
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reports whether the native DevTools panel is currently open for a webview.

nodes.name: get_webview_dom_tree
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns a serialized DOM tree (up to a max depth) for a webview, for the element-inspection panel.

nodes.name: check_webview_dom_dirty
nodes.summary: Tauri command that checks whether the webview's DOM has changed since the tree was last fetched.

nodes.name: highlight_element_by_xpath
nodes.summary: Tauri command that draws an inspector highlight overlay around the DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: select_element_by_xpath
nodes.summary: Tauri command that marks the DOM element matched by XPath as the inspector's selected element.

nodes.name: clear_element_highlight
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes the inspector highlight overlay from a webview.

nodes.name: set_element_style
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets a single CSS property on the DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: get_element_computed_styles
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the full computed CSS style set for the DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: get_element_path
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the source-code location (file/line/component) associated with a DOM element, when source mapping is available.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands that let the frontend start, stop, pause, resume, and query the status of the agent browser automation controller, emitting `browser:status` events to keep the UI in sync.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel that exposes the browser automation Tauri command surface and re-exports `AgentBrowserController` from the shared_state crate for use by frontend commands and agent tools.

nodes.name: capture.rs
nodes.summary: Captures the visible contents of an inline webview as a PNG data URL for attaching to chat inputs, using WKWebView's native snapshot API on macOS.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses objc2/block2 FFI to call Cocoa's WKWebView snapshot API directly from Rust, wrapping the async Objective-C completion handler in an mpsc channel.

nodes.name: cookies.rs
nodes.summary: Provides native, platform-specific cookie access (including HttpOnly cookies invisible to JavaScript) via WKHTTPCookieStore and NSHTTPCookieStorage on macOS.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of unsafe Objective-C interop via objc2 to bridge WKWebView/NSHTTPCookieStorage APIs that have no native Rust equivalent.

nodes.name: dom_editor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CRUD-style DOM editing commands (insert, delete, update, clone, move) plus undo/redo history and multi-element selection for inline webviews, enabling a visual DOM-based design editor.

nodes.name: internal_browser_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Exposes the `window.__PAGE_AGENT__` DOM-automation API injected into inline webviews as direct Tauri commands, letting the frontend click, type, select, and scroll within a webview for testing and debugging.

nodes.name: emit_browser_status
nodes.summary: Emits a `browser:status` Tauri event to the frontend with the current automation status, port, and optional error.

nodes.name: browser_automation_start
nodes.summary: Tauri command that starts the browser automation controller on the selected backend and emits status events as it launches.

nodes.name: browser_automation_stop
nodes.summary: Tauri command that stops the running browser automation controller and emits a stopped status event.

nodes.name: browser_automation_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current running/paused state, port, and URL of the browser automation controller.

nodes.name: browser_automation_takeover
nodes.summary: Tauri command that pauses agent-driven automation so the user can manually take over the browser.

nodes.name: sync.rs
nodes.summary: Core E2E scenarios and shared HTTP helpers for the pluggable sync framework, exercising the full outbox -> adapter -> DB chain (transient-failure recovery, abandon-after-max-retry, force-push, and problems-list shape) via the debug HTTP surface.

nodes.name: unique_slug
nodes.summary: Generates a unique throwaway project slug for a sync scenario using the scenario name and current nanosecond timestamp.

nodes.name: client
nodes.summary: Builds an HTTP client configured for the sync debug endpoints using scenario config.

nodes.name: post_json
nodes.summary: Sends a JSON POST request to a sync debug HTTP endpoint and returns the parsed response body.

nodes.name: get_json
nodes.summary: Sends a JSON GET request to a sync debug HTTP endpoint for a given slug and returns the parsed response.

nodes.name: get_json_query
nodes.summary: Sends a JSON GET request with query parameters to a sync debug HTTP endpoint.

nodes.name: run_scenario_with_cleanup
nodes.summary: Runs a scenario closure and guarantees a cleanup closure executes afterward, even on early return.

nodes.name: seed_project
nodes.summary: Seeds a fresh throwaway project with the Echo sync adapter attached.

nodes.name: seed_project_with_adapter
nodes.summary: Seeds a fresh throwaway project attached to a specific named sync adapter.

nodes.name: enqueue
nodes.summary: Enqueues an outbox operation for a given entity via the sync debug HTTP surface.

nodes.name: pump
nodes.summary: Triggers one pump cycle of the sync outbox worker for a project.

nodes.name: echo_flag
nodes.summary: Toggles a behavior flag on the Echo adapter (e.g. persistent failure mode) for the current or next call.

nodes.name: problems
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of problem/failed outbox rows for a project.

nodes.name: inspect_entry
nodes.summary: Fetches a single outbox entry's full row detail by id for assertions.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Deletes a throwaway sync-scenario project and its associated outbox/state rows.

nodes.name: run_scenario
nodes.summary: Runs a sync scenario body wrapped with automatic project seeding and cleanup for a given slug.

nodes.name: outbox_roundtrip
nodes.summary: Verifies a full outbox roundtrip: enqueue, pump, and confirmation that the operation reaches the adapter and clears from pending.

nodes.name: transient_failure_auto_recovers
nodes.summary: Verifies an outbox entry that transiently fails automatically recovers and succeeds on a later pump without manual intervention.

nodes.name: requeue_after_abandon
nodes.summary: Verifies a requeue on an abandoned outbox entry resets its retry state and allows the entry to succeed on a subsequent pump.

nodes.name: abandon_after_max_attempts
nodes.summary: Verifies an outbox entry that fails past MAX_RETRY_COUNT transitions to Abandoned and stays there rather than oscillating back to pending.

nodes.name: discard_blocks_force_push_resurrection
nodes.summary: Verifies discarding an outbox entry prevents it from being resurrected by a subsequent force_push.

nodes.name: list_problems_shape
nodes.summary: Verifies the OutboxProblemRow JSON shape returned by the problems endpoint matches the documented field set exactly, guarding wire-format drift.

nodes.name: sync_conflict.rs

nodes.name: seed_work_item
nodes.summary: Seeds a work-item entity with locally-modified field revisions for a conflict scenario.

nodes.name: inject_merge_external
nodes.summary: Appends a merge_external outbox row carrying conflicting remote field values.

nodes.name: read_work_item
nodes.summary: Reads back the current field values of a work item for assertions.

nodes.name: conflict_use_local_repushes_local

nodes.name: conflict_use_remote_overwrites_local
nodes.summary: Verifies resolving a conflict with use_remote overwrites local fields with the remote values and stamps resolution without re-pushing (which would loop).

nodes.name: conflict_dismiss_keeps_local
nodes.summary: Verifies dismissing a conflict leaves local fields unchanged, appends no new outbox row, and stamps resolution as dismissed.

nodes.name: mode_switch_accept

nodes.name: spawn_permission_responder

nodes.name: permission_deny
nodes.summary: Verifies that denying a tool-permission prompt lets the agent continue with a denial message instead of freezing.

nodes.name: permission_allow
nodes.summary: Verifies that allowing a tool-permission prompt lets the tool execute normally.

nodes.name: permission_command_confirmation_allow
nodes.summary: Verifies the command-confirmation permission variant allows shell command execution when approved.

nodes.name: permission_always_allow

nodes.name: permission_ask_visibility

nodes.name: resume_filters_orphan_tool_use

nodes.name: orgii_temp_root

nodes.name: scratchpad_filesystem_check
nodes.summary: Asks the agent to write to its scratchpad, then reaches directly into the on-disk scratchpad directory and verifies real files landed there.

nodes.name: todo.rs

nodes.name: manage_todo_write
nodes.summary: Verifies the manage_todo tool's description plus exec-mode system prompt drive the LLM to write a structured checklist instead of only narrating steps.

nodes.name: manage_todo_active_form
nodes.summary: Asks the agent to set activeForm on each todo task and verifies the field reaches the database intact.

nodes.name: manage_todo_dag

nodes.name: manage_todo_dag_list_ready

nodes.name: import_cancel_is_final

nodes.name: sync_oauth.rs

nodes.name: register_file_change
nodes.summary: Registers the callback used to record file-change statistics, invoked once at app startup.

nodes.name: register_git_event
nodes.summary: Registers the callback used to forward git watch events to higher-level crates, invoked once at app startup.

nodes.name: websocket_broadcast

nodes.name: record_file_change
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered file-change callback to record added/removed line counts for a project file, if a callback has been registered.

nodes.name: send_git_event
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered git-event callback to forward a `GitWatchEvent` to higher-level crates, if one has been registered.

nodes.name: GitWatchEvent

nodes.name: force_release_on_exit

nodes.name: lib.rs

nodes.name: load_rules
nodes.summary: Reads and JSON-deserializes automation rules from disk, returning an empty list if the file doesn't exist.

nodes.name: save_rules
nodes.summary: Serializes automation rules to pretty JSON and writes them to disk, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: channel_message.rs
nodes.summary: Trigger listener that subscribes to channel-message broadcast events and fires a TriggerEvent when an incoming message matches an optional regex pattern for a given channel.

nodes.name: spawn_channel_message
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task subscribing to channel messages on a broadcast receiver, matching them against an optional compiled regex, and emitting a TriggerEvent on match.

nodes.name: common.rs
nodes.summary: Shared trigger types: TriggerEvent, GitBroadcastEvent, TriggerContext (broadcast senders passed to every trigger), and TriggerHandle for stopping a running trigger task.

nodes.name: TriggerEvent
nodes.summary: Event payload carrying the id of the automation rule whose trigger condition fired.

nodes.name: GitBroadcastEvent
nodes.summary: Broadcast payload describing a git activity event (operation, repo id, change type) used by the git-activity trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerContext
nodes.summary: Bundle of broadcast senders (git events, channel messages) passed into every trigger spawn function so triggers can subscribe to shared event streams.

nodes.name: TriggerHandle
nodes.summary: Handle to a running trigger's background task, storing an atomic running flag and the JoinHandle so the engine can stop it.

nodes.name: git_activity.rs
nodes.summary: Trigger listener that subscribes to git broadcast events and fires a TriggerEvent when a commit/push/pull/branch/file-change event matches the configured event and repo filters.

nodes.name: spawn_git_activity
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task subscribing to git broadcast events, filtering by event type and optional repo id substring, and emitting a matching TriggerEvent.

nodes.name: webhook.rs
nodes.summary: Trigger listener plus a global webhook route registry: spawns a listener that waits for a registered route to be fired externally, and exposes register/unregister/fire/list_routes for the webhook dispatch mechanism.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a private webhook_registry sub-module (register/unregister/fire/list_routes) backed by a global map, which is how externally-triggered webhook routes reach the waiting trigger task via an mpsc channel.

nodes.name: spawn_webhook
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that registers a webhook route and waits on a channel for external fire() calls, emitting a TriggerEvent on each.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core automation domain types: AutomationRule (with cooldown/fire-count logic), the AutomationTrigger and AutomationAction enums, schedule configuration enums, git event kinds, and the AutomationStatus summary DTO.
nodes.languageNotes: Rule fire-control (cooldown_secs/max_fires) lives directly on AutomationRule via can_fire/record_fire, making the rule itself responsible for rate-limiting rather than the engine.

nodes.name: AutomationRule
nodes.summary: A user-defined automation rule combining a trigger, an action, enable state, and cooldown/max-fire limits, with logic to decide whether it can currently fire.

nodes.name: AutomationTrigger
nodes.summary: Enum of supported trigger kinds: Timer, ScheduledTime, Cron, GitActivity, ChannelMessage, FileWatch, and Webhook, each carrying its own configuration.

nodes.name: ScheduleFrequency
nodes.summary: Enum of recurrence frequencies for scheduled-time triggers: Daily, Weekly, Monthly.

nodes.name: ScheduleMonthlyMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how a monthly schedule resolves a day: fixed day-of-month, weekday-of-month, or last day.

nodes.name: WeekOfMonth
nodes.summary: Enum enumerating which week of the month (First..Last) a weekday-of-month schedule refers to.

nodes.name: ScheduleWeekday
nodes.summary: Enum of weekdays used by scheduled-time and weekday-of-month rules.

nodes.name: GitEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of git activity kinds that can trigger an automation: Commit, Push, Pull, BranchChange, FileChange.

nodes.name: AutomationAction
nodes.summary: Enum of actions an automation rule can execute: InjectPrompt, StartSession, KillSession, SendMessage, InjectToSession, or a Workflow action instance.

nodes.name: WorkflowActionInstance
nodes.summary: Reference to a workflow action definition plus its instance id and JSON data payload, used by the Workflow variant of AutomationAction.

nodes.name: AutomationStatus
nodes.summary: DTO summarizing engine runtime status: running state, active/total rule counts, total fires, uptime, and agent health metrics.

nodes.name: index.tsx

nodes.name: DayView
nodes.summary: Renders the day view: header, all-day event row, and a scrollable time grid of EventCard entries, highlighting the current time when viewing today.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a single calendar event as a clickable card, deriving status-based colors and adapting its layout for month, day, and week view variants.

nodes.name: getEventColor
nodes.summary: Derives background/text/dot colors for an event card from its work-item status or an explicit custom color override.

nodes.name: EventCard
nodes.summary: Event card component that renders as a compact pill in month view or an absolutely positioned block in day/week views, wrapped in a SessionHoverCard.

nodes.name: SpanningEventCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a multi-day event bar spanning across day columns in the month grid, with visual cues for events that continue into adjacent weeks.

nodes.name: getEventColor
nodes.summary: Derives background/text colors for a spanning multi-day event bar from its work-item status or a custom color override.

nodes.name: SpanningEventCard
nodes.summary: Renders a multi-day event as a horizontal bar with continuation-aware rounded corners for events that span into adjacent weeks.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Month-view calendar grid that lays out weeks and days, computes overlapping multi-day event positions per week, and renders SpanningEventCard bars over the day cells.

nodes.name: calculateWeekEvents
nodes.summary: Computes per-week layout (start column, span, stacking row, continuation flags) for events overlapping a given week, packing overlapping events into non-conflicting rows.

nodes.name: MonthView
nodes.summary: Month-grid component that computes weeks/days for the current month, memoizes per-week event layouts, and renders day cells with overlaid SpanningEventCard bars and a '+N more' overflow indicator.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Week-view calendar grid combining a spanning all-day event row with a scrollable time grid of positioned EventCard entries and a live current-time indicator.

nodes.name: calculateSpanningEvents
nodes.summary: Filters events to those overlapping the given week and spanning multiple days or marked all-day, then packs them into non-conflicting stacking rows for the all-day bar.

nodes.name: WeekView
nodes.summary: Week-grid component rendering a header row, an all-day spanning-events row, and a scrollable time grid with per-day EventCard placement and a live current-time indicator.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Central date/time utility and constants module for the CalendarView feature, providing view-mode options, weekday/month name arrays, and pure date-math helpers (parsing, formatting, range boundaries, calendar grid generation, and event time positioning).
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps a shared local-date-utils module (parseApiDate/addLocalDays/etc.) to keep calendar math timezone-consistent; nearly every export is a thin, side-effect-free date helper reused across all views and hooks.

nodes.name: parseDate
nodes.summary: Parses a Date or API date string into a local Date object via the shared parseApiDate utility.

nodes.name: addDays
nodes.summary: Adds a whole number of days to a date using local-day-safe arithmetic.

nodes.name: addWeeks
nodes.summary: Adds a whole number of weeks to a date by delegating to addDays with a 7-day multiplier.

nodes.name: addMonths
nodes.summary: Adds a whole number of months to a date using local-month-safe arithmetic.

nodes.name: getStartOfDay
nodes.summary: Returns a new Date set to the start (00:00:00.000) of the given date's local day.

nodes.name: getEndOfDay
nodes.summary: Returns a new Date set to the end (23:59:59.999) of the given date's local day.

nodes.name: getStartOfWeek
nodes.summary: Returns the start-of-day Date for the first day of the week containing the given date, honoring the configured week-start weekday.

nodes.name: getEndOfWeek
nodes.summary: Returns the end-of-day Date for the last day of the week containing the given date, honoring the configured week-start weekday.

nodes.name: getStartOfMonth
nodes.summary: Returns a Date set to the first day of the given date's month at midnight.

nodes.name: getEndOfMonth
nodes.summary: Returns a Date set to the last day of the given date's month at end of day.

nodes.name: getDaysInMonth
nodes.summary: Returns the number of days in the given date's month.

nodes.name: isSameDay
nodes.summary: Checks whether two dates fall on the same local calendar day.

nodes.name: isToday
nodes.summary: Checks whether the given date is today's local calendar day.

nodes.name: isWeekend
nodes.summary: Checks whether the given date falls on Saturday or Sunday.

nodes.name: isSameMonth
nodes.summary: Checks whether two dates fall in the same calendar month and year.

nodes.name: formatMonthYear
nodes.summary: Formats a date as an abbreviated month and full year (e.g. 'Jan 2026').

nodes.name: formatMonthYearFull
nodes.summary: Formats a date as a full month name and year (e.g. 'January 2026').

nodes.name: formatDayHeader
nodes.summary: Formats a date as an abbreviated weekday and day number for day-column headers.

nodes.name: formatTime
nodes.summary: Formats an hour (0-23) as a 12-hour or 24-hour time-of-day label.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats a date as an abbreviated month/day (optionally including the year) via the shared local formatter.

nodes.name: getMonthCalendarDays
nodes.summary: Builds the full grid of Date objects (including leading/trailing days from adjacent months) needed to render a month calendar view.

nodes.name: getWeekDays
nodes.summary: Builds the array of 7 Date objects for the week containing the given date, honoring the configured week-start weekday.

nodes.name: getTimeSlots
nodes.summary: Generates the array of time-slot label/hour objects between a start and end hour at a given slot-minute interval, for the day/week time grid.

nodes.name: eventSpansDate
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event's start/end range covers a given calendar day.

nodes.name: getEventTimePosition
nodes.summary: Converts an event's time into a top/height percentage pair (clamped to the visible day range) for absolute positioning in the day/week time grid.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the CalendarView feature's three custom hooks (useCalendarNavigation, useCalendarEvents, useCalendarGrid) and their associated option/return types.

nodes.name: useCalendarEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that partitions calendar events by day, computes column layout for overlapping same-day events, and exposes memoized lookup functions for positioned and all-day events per date.

nodes.name: assignColumnsForGroup
nodes.summary: Assigns non-overlapping column indices to a group of concurrently-active events using a greedy first-fit strategy, tracking the total column count per event.

nodes.name: calculateEventColumns
nodes.summary: Groups time-based events by temporal overlap and assigns each group non-conflicting display columns via assignColumnsForGroup, used to render side-by-side overlapping events in day/week views.

nodes.name: useCalendarEvents
nodes.summary: Hook that parses raw calendar events into typed Date fields and returns memoized getters for all-day events and column-positioned time-based events on a given day.

nodes.name: useCalendarGrid.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that derives the day/week/month grid of dates and time slots to render based on the current view mode, current date, and calendar config.

nodes.name: useCalendarGrid
nodes.summary: Hook that computes the day/week/month array of Date objects and the list of time slots to render, memoized against the current view mode, date, and calendar config.

nodes.name: useCalendarNavigation.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook managing the currently focused calendar date, exposing prev/next/today/goToDate navigation callbacks scoped to the active view mode.

nodes.name: useCalendarNavigation
nodes.summary: Hook holding the currently focused calendar date in state and exposing goToPrevious/goToNext/goToToday/goToDate callbacks that step the date by day, week, or month depending on the active view mode.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level reusable CalendarView component that wires together navigation, grid, and event hooks and switches between DayView, WeekView, and MonthView based on the selected view mode.

nodes.name: CalendarView
nodes.summary: Main calendar component that merges config overrides, drives navigation/grid/event hooks, and switches between DayView, WeekView, and MonthView based on the active view mode, with an optional toolbar.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types for the CalendarView feature: CalendarEvent, PositionedEvent, CalendarViewMode, and CalendarConfig (with its default), plus convenience re-exports of Label, Person, and WorkItemStatus.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the Inbox feature's presentational components (ChannelFeedPanel, ChannelListPanel, FeedMessage).

nodes.name: assignmentConverter.ts
nodes.summary: Converts work-item assignment change events into Inbox message objects, filtering to changes relevant to the current user.

nodes.name: converters.ts
nodes.summary: Converts git operations and commits into Inbox message objects and provides seed/demo Inbox messages.

nodes.name: useCommitFiles.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that lazily fetches and caches the changed-files diff for a git commit referenced by an Inbox message.

nodes.name: useInbox.ts
nodes.summary: Central Inbox hook that merges live git-sync messages with persisted ones, exposes search/filtering and date-grouped feeds, and provides read/delete/select actions for the active channel.

nodes.name: useInboxGitSync.ts
nodes.summary: Watches live git operations and periodically-fetched commits, converting them into transient Inbox messages and tracking their local read state before they are persisted.

nodes.name: useWorkItemInboxNotifications.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that watches work-item assignment changes for the current git user and pushes matching notifications into the Inbox.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript type definitions for the Inbox feature: message category, priority/status enums, message shape, and date-grouped feed structure.

nodes.name: assignmentChangeToInboxMessage
nodes.summary: Converts a single work-item assignment change event into an Inbox message describing who was assigned or unassigned.

nodes.name: filterAndConvertAssignmentChanges
nodes.summary: Filters assignment change events to those relevant to the current user's member ids and converts them into Inbox messages.

nodes.name: gitOperationToInboxMessage
nodes.summary: Converts a live, in-progress git operation into a transient Inbox message.

nodes.name: gitCommitToInboxMessage
nodes.summary: Converts a git commit record into an Inbox message with formatted commit summary, author, and merge details.

nodes.name: useCommitFiles
nodes.summary: Hook that fetches the diff for a commit referenced by an Inbox message id, caching results and decoding octal-escaped file paths.

nodes.name: useInbox
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full Inbox feature: merges live git-sync and persisted messages, exposes search, date-grouped feeds, unread counts, and read/delete/select actions.

nodes.name: useInboxGitSync
nodes.summary: Subscribes to live git operations and periodically-fetched commits, converting them into transient Inbox messages and tracking their local read state until persisted.

nodes.name: useWorkItemInboxNotifications
nodes.summary: Watches work-item assignment changes for the current git user's member ids and pushes matching notifications into the Inbox store.

nodes.summary: Thin wrapper rendering a compact, rounded strip of RepoActionButtons for a selected repo in the Launchpad.

nodes.name: LaunchpadActionStrip
nodes.summary: Renders RepoActionButtons in a rounded pill container, passing through repo, onOpenDetails and onClear props.

nodes.name: MacFolderIcon.tsx
nodes.summary: SVG macOS-style folder icon component with color mixing/alpha helpers used to derive gradient shades and an optional centered label.

nodes.name: MacFolderIcon
nodes.summary: Renders a stylized macOS folder SVG icon whose gradient shades and tab color are derived from a base color prop, with an optional truncated label.

nodes.name: RepoDetailConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Static lookup maps and options used by the repo detail view: status dot/text colors keyed by detection status, status label translation keys, and script category select options.

nodes.name: useContainerEngine.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that pings the active container engine and exposes its status, loading, and error state, with a manual refresh trigger.

nodes.name: useContainerEngine
nodes.summary: Polls containerApi.pingEngine() when enabled, tracking status/loading/error in state and exposing a refresh callback that increments a tick to re-trigger the effect.

nodes.name: useContainerEngines.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that lists candidate container engines (local/SSH/WSL) via containerApi, plus a helper to filter out remote engines.

nodes.name: filterRemoteContainerEngines
nodes.summary: Filters a list of container engine candidates down to remote (non-local) engines.

nodes.name: useContainerEngines
nodes.summary: Fetches container engine candidates via containerApi.listEngineCandidates() when enabled, tracking engines/loading/error and exposing a tick-based refresh callback.

nodes.name: useContainers.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that lists containers via containerApi, refreshing both the container engine status and the container list together.

nodes.name: useContainers
nodes.summary: Fetches containers via containerApi.listContainers() when enabled, tracking containers/loading/error, and composes useContainerEngine's refresh so both refresh together.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: File-collection and environment helpers for the advanced-search indexing pipeline, providing gitignore-aware parallel directory walking, GPU layer configuration lookup, and supported file-extension filtering.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregates the advanced-search Tauri command surface, conditionally re-exporting the semantic-search implementation or the no-op stub API based on the `semantic-search` Cargo feature, and exposes a `check_advanced_search_enabled` command.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` to select between two mutually-exclusive module implementations (semantic_commands vs stubs) at compile time.

nodes.name: semantic_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the full set of Tauri commands for semantic code search when the `semantic-search` feature is enabled: model directory/download management, repository indexing (full and incremental), semantic query search, and embedder lifecycle control, with cfg-gated no-op fallbacks for builds without the feature.
nodes.languageNotes: Many functions are declared twice under `#[cfg(feature = "semantic-search")]` and `#[cfg(not(...))]` with the same name; only one variant compiles per build.

nodes.name: stubs.rs
nodes.summary: No-op fallback implementations of the advanced-search Tauri commands used when the `semantic-search` Cargo feature is disabled, returning errors or empty results for every semantic search operation.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the request/response data structures (SearchFilters, IncrementalResult, EmbeddingModelStatus) shared by the advanced-search Tauri command handlers.

nodes.name: ipc.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON-serializable Request/Response message protocol exchanged with the out-of-process embedding subprocess (init, embed, ping, shutdown).

nodes.name: metal.rs
nodes.summary: Implements GPU-accelerated text embedders for macOS/Apple Silicon: a channel-based GpuExecutor for thread-safe Metal access, a GgmlEmbedder wrapper, and a SubprocessEmbedder that manages a crash-recoverable child process communicating over the IPC protocol.
nodes.languageNotes: Platform-gated (macOS aarch64) module implementing process supervision with automatic restart-after-crash logic and a dedicated GPU worker thread communicating via mpsc channels.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Embedder trait abstraction for text-to-vector embedding and provides a MockEmbedder implementation used for testing without a real model.

nodes.name: index.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SemanticIndex, the core vector index wrapper that manages chunk embedding, storage, similarity search, per-repository deletion, and idle-based lifecycle tracking for the semantic search feature.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the optional advanced-search stack; declares the commands, embedders, index, semantic, and types modules and conditionally re-exports the semantic-search public API behind the `semantic-search` Cargo feature.

nodes.name: semantic.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a single feature-availability check (`is_semantic_available`) used to gate semantic search functionality at runtime.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core semantic-search data types (CodeChunkPayload, SemanticHit, SemanticConfig, CodeChunk) plus helper functions for deterministic point-ID generation and sliding-window code chunking.

nodes.name: read_file_content
nodes.summary: Reads a file's contents into a String, returning None on any I/O error.

nodes.name: collect_files
nodes.summary: Parallel, gitignore-aware directory walker (via `ignore::WalkBuilder`) that collects file paths matching extension and directory-exclusion filters for repository indexing.

nodes.name: get_gpu_layers
nodes.summary: Reads the `ORGII_GPU_LAYERS` environment variable to determine how many GPU layers to offload for the embedding model, defaulting to 0.

nodes.name: is_supported_extension
nodes.summary: Checks a file extension against the list of source-code extensions supported for semantic indexing.

nodes.name: check_advanced_search_enabled
nodes.summary: Tauri command reporting whether the crate was compiled with the `semantic-search` feature enabled.

nodes.name: get_model_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the configured embedding model directory, falling back to the platform default if no custom directory was set.

nodes.name: set_model_dir
nodes.summary: Tauri command that validates and persists a custom embedding-model directory path, creating it if necessary.

nodes.name: get_model_dir_path
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the current embedding-model directory as a string, or empty string when semantic search is unavailable.

nodes.name: check_semantic_available
nodes.summary: Tauri command exposing whether semantic search is available on the current platform/build.

nodes.name: ensure_semantic_index
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes the global SemanticIndex on first use, selecting between the subprocess and in-process (Metal GPU) embedder implementations based on platform and environment configuration.

nodes.name: check_embedding_model_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command reporting whether the embedding model files are installed and their combined size on disk.

nodes.name: delete_embedding_model
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes the downloaded embedding model files (gguf weights and tokenizer) from disk.

nodes.name: download_embedding_model
nodes.summary: Tauri command that downloads the embedding model's GGUF weights and tokenizer files over HTTP with resumable, chunked progress reporting emitted to the frontend via Tauri events.

nodes.name: get_model_info
nodes.summary: Tauri command that builds a human-readable diagnostic report describing installed embedding model files and their sizes.

nodes.name: search_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command performing a semantic similarity search against the indexed repositories and returning paginated results.

nodes.name: index_repository_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command that performs a full semantic re-index of a repository: walks matching files, chunks their content, embeds each batch with retry/backoff on transient embedder errors, and reports progress via Tauri events; the largest and most complex command in the crate.

nodes.name: remove_repository_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command that deletes all indexed chunks for a repository from the semantic index.

nodes.name: incremental_index_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command that re-indexes only the specified changed files of a repository, replacing their existing chunks with freshly embedded ones.

nodes.name: cancel_semantic_indexing
nodes.summary: Tauri command that signals cancellation of an in-progress semantic indexing operation for a repository.

nodes.name: stop_embedder
nodes.summary: Tauri command that shuts down the active subprocess embedder, releasing its resources.

nodes.name: debug_qdrant_collection_info
nodes.summary: Tauri diagnostic command that reports internal statistics about the semantic vector index/collection.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Performs a similarity search over the vector index, optionally filtered by repository, and returns the top-matching code chunks.

nodes.name: batch_index_chunks
nodes.summary: Embeds and stores a batch of code chunks into the vector index and metadata database in a single pass.

nodes.name: delete_repo
nodes.summary: Removes all indexed vectors and metadata belonging to a given repository from the index.

nodes.name: is_semantic_available
nodes.summary: Determines at runtime whether semantic search can be used, based on feature compilation and platform/model requirements.

nodes.name: chunk_code
nodes.summary: Splits source code content into overlapping fixed-size chunks suitable for embedding, preserving line-number boundaries.

nodes.name: generate_point_id
nodes.summary: Deterministically derives a vector-database point ID from a repository path, relative file path, and starting line number.

nodes.name: SemanticHit
nodes.summary: Fallback definition of a semantic search hit result used when the `semantic-search` feature is disabled, mirroring the shape of the real SemanticHit type.

nodes.name: SearchFilters
nodes.summary: Request payload describing file-extension, directory-exclusion, and case/regex options for a code search operation.

nodes.name: IncrementalResult
nodes.summary: Result payload summarizing the outcome of an incremental indexing operation, including updated/failed file counts.

nodes.name: EmbeddingModelStatus
nodes.summary: Status payload describing whether the embedding model is installed and its on-disk size.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Enum of messages sent to the embedding subprocess: Init, Embed, Ping, Shutdown.

nodes.name: Response
nodes.summary: Enum of messages received from the embedding subprocess: Ready, Result, Pong, Error, Bye.

nodes.name: GpuExecutor
nodes.summary: Wraps a dedicated GPU worker thread behind an mpsc channel so Metal-backed embedding calls can be safely invoked from async/multi-threaded Tauri command handlers.

nodes.name: GgmlEmbedder
nodes.summary: In-process GGML/Metal embedder implementation used on Apple Silicon to compute text embeddings without spawning a subprocess.

nodes.name: SubprocessEmbedder
nodes.summary: Manages a long-lived child process running the embedding model, communicating via the IPC protocol, with automatic crash detection and restart.

nodes.name: Embedder
nodes.summary: Trait abstraction for text-to-vector embedding, implemented by both the mock and real (Metal/subprocess) embedder backends.

nodes.name: MockEmbedder
nodes.summary: Deterministic in-memory Embedder implementation used in tests to avoid loading a real model.

nodes.name: SemanticIndex
nodes.summary: Central vector-index type coordinating an embedder, vector store, and metadata database to index, search, and delete code chunks per repository.

nodes.name: CodeChunkPayload
nodes.summary: Serializable payload describing a single indexed code chunk (repo, path, language, content, line range, content hash) stored in the vector database.

nodes.name: SemanticHit
nodes.summary: Search result type describing a matched code chunk and its similarity score.

nodes.name: SemanticConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the semantic index: collection name, embedding model identifier, and chunking parameters.

nodes.name: CodeChunk
nodes.summary: In-memory representation of a chunked slice of source code with its line range and content hash.

nodes.name: finalize.rs
nodes.summary: Shared finalization helpers for human-in-the-loop interactions (questions, permissions, mode switches, secrets), providing a cancellable async wait helper and a unified event that records how an interaction concluded.

nodes.name: InteractionOutcome
nodes.summary: Enum of outcome variants (Responded/Cancelled/TimedOut/AutoResponded/Dropped) used to classify how an interaction ended.

nodes.name: AutoTimeoutAction
nodes.summary: Enum describing what happens when an auto-timeout policy expires (Respond with default vs Report).

nodes.name: AutoTimeoutPolicy
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a timeout Duration with an AutoTimeoutAction, used to configure auto-resolution behavior.

nodes.name: FinalizedStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of terminal statuses (Answered/Cancelled/TimedOut/Rejected) with an as_str accessor for serialization.

nodes.name: await_with_cancel
nodes.summary: Generic async helper that races a future against a cancellation flag/channel, returning early if cancellation is signaled.

nodes.name: finalize_interaction_event
nodes.summary: Central function called by all interaction managers (questions, permissions, mode switches, secrets) to emit a standardized completion event/log entry once an interaction resolves.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the interaction subsystem, declaring and re-exporting the finalize, mode_switch, permission, permission_rules, plan_approval, presence_policy, presence_state, profile_state, question, and secret_broker submodules that together implement human-in-the-loop interaction handling.

nodes.name: permission.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the agent's tool-permission approval flow, tracking pending permission prompts per session, evaluating always-allow rules, and persisting granted permissions to a per-workspace store.

nodes.name: PermissionResponse
nodes.summary: Enum of user permission decisions (Allow/Deny/AlwaysAllow) with a from_wire parser.

nodes.name: AgentPermissionManager
nodes.summary: Central manager tracking pending permission requests, session-scoped rules, and a persistent always-allow rule store per workspace.

nodes.name: from_wire
nodes.summary: Parses a wire-format permission response string into a PermissionResponse enum value.

nodes.name: for_agent_with_cancel_flag
nodes.summary: Constructs an AgentPermissionManager scoped to an agent/session with a shared cancellation flag and default persistent store.

nodes.name: set_workspace
nodes.summary: Loads the persistent PermissionStore for a given workspace path and swaps it into the manager.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a new pending permission request awaiting the user's decision.

nodes.name: respond
nodes.summary: Resolves a pending permission request, optionally persists an always-allow rule, and finalizes the interaction event.

nodes.name: cancel_pending
nodes.summary: Cancels a pending permission request and records the cancellation as a finalized interaction event.

nodes.name: build_rule
nodes.summary: Builds a PermissionRule from a tool name and call parameters for always-allow matching.

nodes.name: add_always_allowed
nodes.summary: Adds a new always-allow rule to the session's rule set.

nodes.name: check_always_allowed
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tool call matches an existing always-allow rule.

nodes.name: request_permission
