nodes.name: permission_rules.rs
nodes.summary: Defines glob-style permission rules and a JSON-backed PermissionStore for persisting per-workspace always-allow decisions used by the tool-permission approval flow.

nodes.name: PermissionRule
nodes.summary: Represents a single always-allow rule (tool + matcher pattern) with parsing and glob-based matching logic.

nodes.name: PermissionStore
nodes.summary: JSON file-backed store of allow/deny PermissionRules for a workspace, with load/save/query operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PermissionRule from a tool name and raw pattern string.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a raw permission-rule string (tool:pattern format) into a PermissionRule.

nodes.name: matches
nodes.summary: Tests whether a tool call's matchable content satisfies this rule's pattern.

nodes.name: extract_matchable_content
nodes.summary: Extracts the string content from tool-call parameters that should be matched against permission rule patterns.

nodes.name: glob_match
nodes.summary: Implements simple glob-style wildcard matching between a pattern and candidate string.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads the PermissionStore's allow/deny rules from the workspace's permissions.json file, tolerating missing/corrupt files.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Persists the current allow/deny rules to the workspace's permissions.json file.

nodes.name: persistence.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence layer for pending plan approvals, providing schema initialization and CRUD operations (load/upsert/delete/list) used by the PlanApprovalManager to survive restarts.

nodes.name: PendingPlanRow
nodes.summary: Row struct mirroring the pending_plan_approvals SQLite table columns.

nodes.name: StoreError
nodes.summary: Error type wrapping SQLite errors for the plan approval store.

nodes.name: PlanApprovalStore
nodes.summary: Namespace/struct exposing static CRUD methods over the pending_plan_approvals table.

nodes.name: init_schema
nodes.summary: Creates the pending_plan_approvals SQLite table and indexes if they don't already exist.

nodes.name: load_by_session
nodes.summary: Loads the pending plan row for a given session ID, if any.

nodes.name: upsert
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a pending plan row keyed by session ID.

nodes.name: delete_by_session
nodes.summary: Deletes the pending plan row for a given session ID.

nodes.name: list_all
nodes.summary: Lists all pending plan rows currently stored.

nodes.name: presence_policy.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective auto-resolve/auto-approve/goal-loop presence policy for a session from wire-format fields, including backward-compatible mapping of legacy presence-mode payloads to the new policy shape.

nodes.name: AutoResolve
nodes.summary: Enum representing whether a prompt type auto-resolves Off or After a duration.

nodes.name: GoalLoopPolicy
nodes.summary: Enum representing whether goal-loop auto-continuation is Off or On with a max-turns cap.

nodes.name: PresencePolicy
nodes.summary: Aggregate policy struct bundling auto-resolve settings for questions, plans, mode switches, goal loop, and prompt stance.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Returns the built-in default PresencePolicy (all auto-resolve features off).

nodes.name: built_in_defaults
nodes.summary: Returns the built-in default policy for a given legacy presence mode string.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective PresencePolicy from a wire payload, falling back to legacy mode-based defaults for unset fields.

nodes.name: resolve_opt
nodes.summary: Resolves an optional wire payload into a PresencePolicy, falling back to the default when absent.

nodes.name: presence_state.rs
nodes.summary: Holds process-global presence state (the currently resolved PresencePolicy) behind a broadcast channel so other interaction managers can read or subscribe to the active presence policy.

nodes.name: set_global_presence
nodes.summary: Updates the global presence state from a wire payload and broadcasts the change to subscribers.

nodes.name: global_policy
nodes.summary: Returns the currently resolved global PresencePolicy, falling back to defaults if unset.

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.summary: Returns a receiver for the global presence broadcast channel.

nodes.name: profile_state.rs
nodes.summary: Holds process-global agent profile state (e.g., active persona/settings) accessible to other interaction managers.

nodes.name: set_global_profile
nodes.summary: Updates the global agent profile state from an incoming value.

nodes.name: question.rs
nodes.summary: Manages pending clarifying-question prompts sent to the user, supporting multi-question batches, auto-resolution after a policy-driven timeout, cancellation, and formatting of answers for the LLM.

nodes.name: QuestionResolution
nodes.summary: Enum describing how a question was resolved (Answered/AutoSkipped).

nodes.name: QuestionManager
nodes.summary: Core manager tracking the pending question batch, answer metadata, and cancellation state; exposes ask/respond/reject/auto-resolve operations.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Registers a new pending question (or batch of questions) and returns a receiver awaited for the user's answers.

nodes.name: spawn_auto_resolve_watcher
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that auto-resolves the pending question once the presence-policy timeout elapses.

nodes.name: take_pending
nodes.summary: Removes and returns the currently pending question, if any.

nodes.name: respond
nodes.summary: Resolves the pending question with the user's answers and finalizes the interaction event.

nodes.name: reject
nodes.summary: Rejects the pending question without answers, finalizing it as a rejected interaction.

nodes.name: cancel_pending
nodes.summary: Cancels the pending question, notifying the waiting caller.

nodes.name: update_auto_resolve_metadata
nodes.summary: Updates the stored metadata describing how the pending question should auto-resolve.

nodes.name: auto_resolve_pending
nodes.summary: Auto-resolves the pending question using its configured default/skip behavior once triggered.

nodes.name: resolve_answer_labels
nodes.summary: Maps raw answer values to their human-readable option labels for display/logging.

nodes.name: format_answers_for_llm
nodes.summary: Formats the resolved question and answers into a text block suitable for feeding back to the LLM.

nodes.name: secret_broker.rs
nodes.summary: Brokers short-lived secret capture from the user (e.g., API keys/passwords) with a TTL, ensuring plaintext values are never exposed to the LLM/UI directly and are purged after use or expiry.

nodes.name: SecretCapture
nodes.summary: Enum representing the outcome of a secret-capture request (Submitted/Cancelled).

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.summary: Enum representing the result of resolving a stored secret token (Plaintext/Expired/Unknown).

nodes.name: SecretMetadata
nodes.summary: Metadata about a captured secret (token, label, kind, expiry, length) safe to expose without revealing plaintext.

nodes.name: SecretBroker
nodes.summary: Core broker tracking pending secret-capture requests and TTL-bound stored plaintext secrets, exposing ask/submit/resolve/take/purge operations.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Registers a new pending secret-capture request and returns a receiver awaited for the user's submission.

nodes.name: submit
nodes.summary: Submits a captured secret value, storing it with a TTL and finalizing the pending capture request.

nodes.name: cancel
nodes.summary: Cancels a pending secret-capture request without storing any value.

nodes.name: cancel_pending
nodes.summary: Cancels a pending secret-capture request by session/tool-call ID.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a secret token to its plaintext value, checking expiry.

nodes.name: take
nodes.summary: Removes and returns a stored secret's plaintext, consuming it (single use).

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Lists metadata for all currently stored secrets without exposing plaintext.

nodes.name: allShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates every category-specific keyboard shortcut array (global, editor, browser, database, source control, spotlight, overlay, project) into a single ALL_SHORTCUTS list consumed by the rest of the app.

nodes.name: browserShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of keyboard shortcut entries scoped to the in-app browser (tabs, navigation, reload, etc.).

nodes.name: databaseShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of keyboard shortcut entries scoped to database-related views and commands.

nodes.name: displayConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Provides display metadata (labels and sort order) used to render shortcut categories and scopes in the keyboard shortcuts UI.

nodes.name: editorShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of keyboard shortcut entries scoped to the code editor (file operations, navigation, editing commands).
nodes.languageNotes: A long but flat array of shortcut object literals; size comes from data volume rather than logical complexity.

nodes.name: globalShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of application-wide (global scope) keyboard shortcut entries such as window and navigation commands.
nodes.languageNotes: A long but flat array of shortcut object literals; size comes from data volume rather than logical complexity.

nodes.name: helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Provides query helper functions to filter and enumerate shortcut entries from ALL_SHORTCUTS by category or scope, ordered using displayConfig metadata.

nodes.name: overlayShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of keyboard shortcut entries scoped to overlay UI surfaces (modals, lists, context menus).

nodes.name: sourceControlShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of keyboard shortcut entries scoped to source control / hunk-review commands.

nodes.name: spotlightShortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the static list of keyboard shortcut entries scoped to the spotlight/search overlay.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the shared TypeScript types (ShortcutScope, ShortcutCategory, ShortcutEntry) that define the shape of every keyboard shortcut entry across the app.

nodes.name: getShortcutsByCategory
nodes.summary: Filters ALL_SHORTCUTS down to the entries matching a given shortcut category.

nodes.name: getShortcutsByScope
nodes.summary: Filters ALL_SHORTCUTS down to the entries matching a given shortcut scope.

nodes.name: getCategories
nodes.summary: Derives the sorted, de-duplicated list of shortcut categories present in ALL_SHORTCUTS, ordered using CATEGORY_CONFIG.

nodes.name: getScopes
nodes.summary: Derives the de-duplicated list of shortcut scopes present in ALL_SHORTCUTS.

nodes.name: diagnosis.ts
nodes.summary: Diagnostic helper that inspects background-image storage health (orphaned metadata keys, storage size) and prints actionable recommendations for troubleshooting.

nodes.name: fileSearch.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps native Tauri file-search and project-indexing commands (search, index, prewarm, clear-cache) with readiness checks and result-shape conversion for the file browser UI.

nodes.name: fileUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Provides Tauri-native (Rust-backed) implementations of binary-file detection and gitignore-pattern filtering, each paired with a JS-fallback path for use outside the Tauri runtime.

nodes.name: folderArchive.ts
nodes.summary: Creates zip archives of folders through a Tauri backend command with progress event streaming, and converts the resulting base64 payload into a downloadable File object.

nodes.name: init.ts
nodes.summary: Core Tauri IPC bridge module: lazily loads the @tauri-apps/api core/event modules, exposes tracked invokeTauri/listenTauri wrappers, readiness checks, and a base64-to-File conversion helper used throughout the app's native integration layer.
nodes.languageNotes: invokeTauri wraps every native call through an optional API-usage tracker (getTracker) that instruments timing and suppresses recursive tracking during the call.

nodes.name: retryInvoke.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps invokeTauri with exponential-backoff retry behavior specifically for rate-limit errors, logging an error event to the event store once retries are exhausted.

nodes.name: diagnoseBackgroundStorage
nodes.summary: Inspects background-image storage state (disk metadata, localStorage keys, orphaned entries) and builds a structured diagnostics report with actionable recommendations.

nodes.name: displayDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Runs the background-storage diagnostic and logs the resulting report for developer inspection.

nodes.name: searchFilesNative
nodes.summary: Invokes the native Tauri file-search command with the given options, ensuring the Tauri bridge is ready and logging failures.

nodes.name: indexProjectFiles
nodes.summary: Triggers native indexing of a project's files (excluding given directories) via the Tauri backend.

nodes.name: prewarmFileIndex
nodes.summary: Best-effort call to warm the native file-search index for a project root, silently degrading if Tauri isn't ready or the call fails.

nodes.name: clearFileIndexCache
nodes.summary: Clears the native file-search index cache via the Tauri backend if available.

nodes.name: isNativeSearchAvailable
nodes.summary: Reports whether native Tauri-backed file search is currently available.

nodes.name: convertToSearchResultItems
nodes.summary: Converts native search results (files and folders) into the unified SearchResultItem shape used by the UI.

nodes.name: searchFilesNativeSafe
nodes.summary: Safely wraps searchFilesNative, converting results to SearchResultItems and returning an empty array instead of throwing on failure.

nodes.name: isTauriFileUtilsAvailable
nodes.summary: Checks whether native Tauri file-utility commands can be invoked.

nodes.name: isBinaryByExtensionNative
nodes.summary: Asks the native Tauri backend whether a file path's extension indicates a binary file.

nodes.name: isBinaryContentNative
nodes.summary: Asks the native Tauri backend whether a byte sample's content looks binary.

nodes.name: isBinaryFileNative
nodes.summary: Native combined binary-file check that consults extension and, optionally, content via the Tauri backend.

nodes.name: shouldIgnorePathNative
nodes.summary: Asks the native Tauri backend whether a relative path matches the given gitignore patterns.

nodes.name: shouldIgnorePathsBatchNative
nodes.summary: Batch variant of shouldIgnorePathNative that checks many relative paths against gitignore patterns in a single native call.

nodes.name: filterIgnoredPathsNative
nodes.summary: Filters a list of relative paths down to those NOT matching the gitignore patterns, using the native Tauri backend.

nodes.name: isBinaryFile
nodes.summary: Public binary-file check that prefers the native Tauri implementation and falls back to a JS-based heuristic outside the Tauri runtime.

nodes.name: shouldIgnorePath
nodes.summary: Public gitignore-match check that prefers the native Tauri implementation and falls back to a JS gitignore matcher outside Tauri.

nodes.name: filterIgnoredPaths
nodes.summary: Public batch path filter that prefers the native Tauri implementation and falls back to per-path JS gitignore matching.

nodes.name: createFolderArchive
nodes.summary: Invokes the native Tauri command to zip a folder, subscribing to progress events and cleaning up the event listener on completion or error.

nodes.name: getFolderInfo
nodes.summary: Fetches size/file-count metadata for a folder via the Tauri backend.

nodes.name: archiveToFile
nodes.summary: Converts a folder-archive result's base64 zip payload into a downloadable browser File object.

nodes.name: createFolderArchiveAsFile
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that creates a folder archive and immediately converts it into a File object.

nodes.name: isArchiveAvailable
nodes.summary: Reports whether native folder-archiving is available (i.e. running under Tauri).

nodes.name: createFolderArchiveSafe
nodes.summary: Safely creates a folder archive as a File, returning null and logging a warning instead of throwing on failure.

nodes.name: isTauri
nodes.summary: Detects whether the app is currently running inside the Tauri desktop runtime.

nodes.name: initializeTauriAPIs
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the @tauri-apps/api core and event modules and wires up the shared invoke/listen handles used by invokeTauri and listenTauri.

nodes.name: getTauriAPIs
nodes.summary: Returns the current Tauri state object (availability flag, invoke/listen handles).

nodes.name: getTracker
nodes.summary: Lazily imports and caches the API usage tracker module used to instrument Tauri invoke calls.

nodes.summary: Central wrapper for invoking Tauri backend commands, instrumenting each call with the API tracker (timing/args/result) while suppressing recursive tracking during the invoke.

nodes.name: listenTauri
nodes.summary: Subscribes to a native Tauri event, returning an unlisten function once the Tauri APIs are ready.

nodes.name: isTauriReady
nodes.summary: Checks whether the Tauri APIs have finished initializing and are available for use.

nodes.name: ensureTauriReady
nodes.summary: Awaits Tauri API initialization if not already ready, guaranteeing invoke/listen are usable afterward.

nodes.name: base64ToFile
nodes.summary: Decodes a base64 string into a binary File object with the given filename and MIME type.

nodes.name: resetTauriState
nodes.summary: Resets the internal Tauri state object to its initial defaults, primarily for tests.

nodes.name: retryInvokeTauri
nodes.summary: Calls invokeTauri and automatically retries with backoff when the failure looks like a rate-limit error, logging a persistent error event once retries are exhausted.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the centralized repo Jotai store, re-exporting repo/branch types, core and derived atoms, branch-cache LRU helpers, and window-scoped repo storage utilities.

nodes.name: backgroundInit.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes the app's background image at startup, using an in-memory blob-URL cache with LRU eviction and racing image decode against a timeout before falling back to the default background.

nodes.name: chunkReload.ts
nodes.summary: Implements a bounded automatic reload strategy for JS chunk-load failures, tracking attempt count in sessionStorage and invoking a give-up callback once the retry budget is exhausted.

nodes.name: addToBackgroundCache
nodes.summary: Adds a blob URL to the background-image cache, evicting and revoking the oldest entry once the cache exceeds its size limit.

nodes.name: preloadImage
nodes.summary: Preloads an image element and resolves once decoding completes or the image errors, wrapped as a Promise.

nodes.name: loadDefaultBackground
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the app's built-in default background image, returning the cached blob URL if already loaded.

nodes.name: initBackgroundImage
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted background-image selection from storage, loads it as a blob URL with a timeout race, and falls back to the default background on failure or absence.

nodes.name: reloadForChunkError
nodes.summary: Reloads the page after a chunk-load error, tracking the attempt count in sessionStorage and invoking the onGiveUp callback instead of reloading once the max retry count is reached.

nodes.name: resetChunkReloadCount
nodes.summary: Clears the sessionStorage counter tracking chunk-reload attempts.

nodes.name: apiTrackerState.ts
nodes.summary: Central in-memory state store for the API tracker: holds recorded API calls, tracking/tracing enabled flags, and a request timing map, and dispatches update events to the UI.

nodes.name: apiTrackerTimers.ts

nodes.name: apiTrackerUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for the API tracker: resolving hovered/selected DOM component info, filtering and parsing stack traces, and generating unique request ids.

nodes.name: hotspotRates.ts
nodes.summary: Small math helpers shared by the hotspot aggregation functions across the tracker: computing per-minute event rates and effective observation windows.

nodes.name: addApiCall
nodes.summary: Adds a new API call record to the front of the in-memory list, capping the list at a maximum size.

nodes.name: finishRequestTiming
nodes.summary: Computes and returns the elapsed duration for a request by its id, removing it from the pending timing map.

nodes.name: dispatchApiCallUpdated
nodes.summary: Dispatches a custom DOM event notifying listeners that an API call record has been added or updated.

nodes.name: captureTimerSource
nodes.summary: Captures a filtered call stack and component context describing where a timer was scheduled.

nodes.name: recordTimerFire
nodes.summary: Records a timer fire event (interval/timeout/requestAnimationFrame) with its id, kind, delay, and source info into the tracked event buffer.

nodes.name: setWindowTimerFunction
nodes.summary: Replaces a global window timer function with a patched version while preserving the original for later restoration.

nodes.name: restoreWindowTimerFunction
nodes.summary: Restores a previously patched global window timer function back to its original implementation.

nodes.name: installTimerTracking
nodes.summary: Installs patched setInterval, setTimeout, and requestAnimationFrame wrappers that record every timer/animation-frame fire for hotspot analysis.

nodes.name: getTimerHotspots
nodes.summary: Groups recorded timer fire events by key and computes per-hotspot rate and likely-loop metrics within an observation window.

nodes.name: getComponentInfo
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable component descriptor (tag, classes, data-testid) from the currently hovered DOM element for attribution in tracked calls.

nodes.name: getFilteredStack
nodes.summary: Filters a raw stack trace to remove tracker-internal frames, node_modules entries, and ignored substrings, returning a concise relevant stack snippet.

nodes.name: getApiStack
nodes.summary: Returns a filtered call stack with API-tracker-internal frames removed.

nodes.name: getTauriStack
nodes.summary: Returns a filtered call stack with Tauri-tracker-internal frames removed.

nodes.name: extractFunctionNameFromStackLine
nodes.summary: Parses a single stack trace line to extract the calling function's name across different browser stack trace formats.

nodes.name: extractSourceLocationFromStackLine
nodes.summary: Parses a single stack trace line to extract the source file path and line number.

nodes.name: extractFileInfo
nodes.summary: Parses a raw stack trace into structured file path, line number, function name, and component context for a tracked call.

nodes.name: ratePerMinuteInWindow
nodes.summary: Computes the events-per-minute rate for a count of events occurring within a given time window.

nodes.name: effectiveObservationWindowMs
nodes.summary: Clamps the configured observation window to the elapsed time since tracking started, bounded by a minimum window size.

nodes.name: spansRepeatedActivity
nodes.summary: Determines whether a set of timestamps spans at least a minimum duration, indicating repeated rather than one-off activity.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Modular entry point for the component issue tracker, re-exporting hover tracking, inspect-mode controls, element navigation, and issue payload/preview builders used for interactive UI bug reporting.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure barrel file that re-exports types and functions from sibling modules (./types, ./state, ./hoverTracking, ./inspectMode, ./elementNavigation, ./payloadBuilder, ./previewGenerator) without defining any logic itself.

nodes.name: apiTrackerInteractions.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks the most recent user interaction (click, hover, keyboard, focus) so API calls can be attributed to the interaction that triggered them versus classified as automatic background activity.

nodes.name: apiTrackerPush.ts
nodes.summary: Records push/streaming events (e.g. websocket or SSE-style messages) and computes hotspot statistics to identify high-frequency or likely-streaming event sources.

nodes.name: detectInteractionType
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current API call should be attributed to a recent user interaction or classified as automatic/background activity.

nodes.name: installInteractionTracking
nodes.summary: Registers DOM event listeners for click, mousemove, keydown, and focus interactions used to attribute tracked API calls.

nodes.name: cleanupInteractionTracking
nodes.summary: Removes the DOM interaction event listeners installed by installInteractionTracking.

nodes.name: recordPushEvent
nodes.summary: Appends a new push event with timestamp to the tracked event buffer, trimming the buffer to a maximum size.

nodes.name: getPushHotspots
nodes.summary: Groups recorded push events by kind/name and computes per-hotspot rate metrics and likely-stream detection within an observation window.

nodes.name: plugins.rs

nodes.name: real_user_db

nodes.name: discover_cached_plugins

nodes.name: parse_skill_frontmatter

nodes.name: cursor_plugins_list

nodes.name: CursorPluginHook
nodes.summary: Serializable struct describing a single hook entry from a plugin's cursor-hooks.json (event type, label, file path).

nodes.name: CursorPluginInfo
nodes.summary: Serializable struct aggregating all metadata for one installed Cursor plugin (name, description, version, MCP config, skills, hooks, logo path) returned to the frontend.

nodes.name: resolve_config_path

nodes.name: cli_config_file_read_raw

nodes.name: lib.rs
