nodes.name: useWorkspaceUI
nodes.summary: Reads and exposes the full workspace UI state (tabs, active view, panel visibility, loading flags, context-add modal, mode flags) by subscribing to all UI atoms plus the shared isPlannerLiteAtom via useAtom.

nodes.name: useCenterTab
nodes.summary: Fine-grained selector hook that subscribes only to the selected center tab atom.

nodes.name: usePageLoading
nodes.summary: Fine-grained selector hook exposing focus-file, plan-page, and diff-page loading flags for components that only need loading indicators.

nodes.name: useActiveView
nodes.summary: Fine-grained selector hook that reads and updates the active left-menu view atom.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared configuration constants (debounce, batch, flush, and timeout intervals) and enum-like maps for activity, search-scope, and error types used by the Flow Awareness activity tracking system.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type and interface definitions for the Flow Awareness system, covering activity inputs, flow summaries, and the useFlowAwareness hook's option/return contracts.
nodes.languageNotes: Type definitions are designed to mirror corresponding Rust backend structs so the Tauri IPC boundary stays consistent between frontend and backend.

nodes.name: useFlowAwareness.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that batches, deduplicates, debounces, and flushes user activity events (file edits, terminal commands, searches, git ops, errors) to the Rust backend over Tauri RPC, and exposes getContext/getSummary/clearSession query methods.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses refs plus useCallback extensively to implement an in-memory debounced batching queue without triggering re-renders on every recorded activity.

nodes.name: useGlobalFlowTracker.ts
nodes.summary: React hook mounted at the app root that subscribes to Tauri file:changed, repo:changed, and lint:tool_completed events and forwards them into the Flow Awareness activity tracker via useFlowAwareness.

nodes.name: useFlowAwareness
nodes.summary: Implements activity batching/debouncing/flushing logic with refs and useCallback, and returns recordActivity/recordFileEdit/recordTerminalCommand/etc. convenience functions plus getContext, getSummary, and clearSession RPC query methods.

nodes.name: useGlobalFlowTracker
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Tauri events (file:changed, repo:changed, lint:tool_completed) on mount and records corresponding file edit, git operation, and lint error activities via useFlowAwareness, cleaning up listeners on unmount.

nodes.name: resolveModelDisplaySelection.ts
nodes.summary: Provides resolveModelDisplaySelection, a pure function that determines which model id to display for a session, applying the account's persisted default variant to bare base-model selections in active sessions while leaving explicit effort/variant choices and historical sessions untouched.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ModelAccountInfo type used to aggregate per-model key-vault account statistics (total keys and agent types).

nodes.name: useModelAccountLookup.ts
nodes.summary: Provides model-to-account lookup utilities and the useModelAccountLookup hook, which builds a memoized map from model id to aggregated key-vault account info for use in model selection UI.

nodes.name: useModelEffortSegment.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the useModelEffortSegment hook that computes the editable effort/variant segment shown alongside a session's selected model, including label formatting and persisting the chosen variant as the account default.

nodes.name: resolveModelDisplaySelection
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective model id for an active own-key session, applying the selected account's persisted default variant when the stored selection is a bare base model without an explicit effort/variant choice.

nodes.name: accountHasModel
nodes.summary: Pure predicate checking whether a key-vault account has a given model id enabled, including account-level enabled models and derived variant/effort rows.

nodes.name: accountModelIds
nodes.summary: Collects the full set of model ids exposed by an account, combining availableModels with model ids derived from modelVariants.

nodes.name: buildAccountLookup
nodes.summary: Builds a map from model id to aggregated account info (key count and agent types) across all ready key-vault accounts.

nodes.name: useModelAccountLookup
nodes.summary: React hook that loads key-vault accounts and returns a memoized model-to-account lookup map alongside the raw accounts array.

nodes.name: useModelEffortSegment
nodes.summary: React hook powering the chat input's model-effort segment: resolves the display model/variant, determines whether the effort/variant is user-editable, computes the effort label, and provides handlers to apply and persist a new variant selection.

nodes.name: TerminalSettingsSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings section component for configuring the integrated terminal's shell type and an optional custom shell path, with debounced persistence.

nodes.name: TerminalSection
nodes.summary: React component that reads/writes shell type and custom shell path atoms, debouncing custom path saves and showing success toasts on change.

nodes.name: colors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared CSS-variable-based color constants (status, priority, health, entity, label, and milestone palettes) used across the Project Manager module for consistent theming.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `as const` object/array literals backed by CSS custom properties (var(--color-*)) so palettes stay in sync with the app theme.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the Projects page's UI components (ProjectRow, ProjectsPageHeader, RepoSettings) for simplified imports elsewhere.

nodes.name: projectsUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility types, constants, and date/label helpers for the Projects page, including project status label mapping and target-date bucket classification.

nodes.name: getProjectStatusLabelKey
nodes.summary: Maps a project status value to its i18n translation key, special-casing 'in_progress'.

nodes.name: getTargetDateGroup
nodes.summary: Classifies a project's target date into a bucket (overdue, this week, this month, later, or no target date) relative to today.

nodes.name: DiffSummary.tsx
nodes.summary: Small presentational component that renders a compact added/removed line-count badge for a file diff, wrapping DiffStatsBadge with a plain, extra-small variant.

nodes.name: DiffSummary
nodes.summary: Functional component that renders a DiffStatsBadge configured with added/removed line counts, a plain variant, and custom stat number formatting.

nodes.name: KeyHealthBadge.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable badge component that displays a key's health status (valid, degraded, invalid) with contextual messaging for local credentials or market listings.

nodes.name: KeyHealthBadge
nodes.summary: Renders a health status badge with contextual copy for valid, degraded, or invalid keys, including failure counts, cooldown timing, and upstream status hints.

nodes.name: GlobalModals.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders app-wide modal entry points (login modal, component-issue modal) and lazily loads their heavyweight bodies only once their trigger state becomes active.

nodes.name: MainContentArea.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable wrapper for the main content area shared across all layouts, applying CSS containment to isolate layout reflows during route transitions.

nodes.name: ComponentIssueModalLoader
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the ComponentIssueModalProvider only once its atom-driven open state or a 'show-component-issue' window event requests it.

nodes.name: GlobalModals
nodes.summary: Top-level component that conditionally renders the lazy-loaded LoginModal based on visibility atom state and always mounts ComponentIssueModalLoader inside a Suspense boundary.

nodes.name: MainContentAreaComponent
nodes.summary: Renders a flex container with CSS containment (layout/style) around its children to prevent layout thrashing during page transitions; wrapped in memo and exported as MainContentArea.

nodes.name: tokens.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared Tailwind class-name constants for SubpageLayout's scroll container and content wrapper, reused by the main Settings content area to keep spacing consistent.

nodes.name: PreviewBottomBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Generic bottom-bar chrome shared by all file preview components (image, video), providing left/right slot layout and a byte-size formatting utility used across previews.

nodes.name: formatFileSize
nodes.summary: Formats a byte count into a human-readable B/KB/MB/GB string for consistent display across all file preview bottom bars.

nodes.name: PreviewBottomBar
nodes.summary: Shared fixed-height bottom bar layout with left and right content slots used by image and video preview components.

nodes.name: GitCommitRow.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a single row in the git commit history list/graph view, showing commit summary, author, and relative time, with an optional SVG lane graph glyph for merge/branch visualization.

nodes.name: GitCommitRowComponent
nodes.summary: Generic row component (default-exported via a memoized wrapper) that renders a commit's summary, author, and relative timestamp, plus an SVG graph glyph when lane/branch topology is provided.

nodes.name: graphLayout.ts
nodes.summary: Incremental git commit graph layout engine that assigns visual lanes and colors to commits based on parent-SHA relationships, producing metro-map-style line segments for SVG rendering.

nodes.name: allocateLane
nodes.summary: Finds the first free lane index in the lane pool, extending the pool with a new lane if none is available.

nodes.name: createGraphState
nodes.summary: Creates an empty incremental graph-layout state (lane pool and node map) used to accumulate commit graph rendering data across paginated loads.

nodes.name: assignLanesIncremental
nodes.summary: Core incremental lane-assignment algorithm that processes a batch of commits against existing graph state, allocating and reusing lanes for branches/merges and emitting positioned graph nodes with connecting line segments.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript interfaces (SearchMatch, SearchResultFile) describing the shape of code-search results and per-line match context consumed by the search results components.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting helpers that truncate and split a search match's before/match/after context into display segments, with a fallback that derives context from column/end_column ranges when the backend omits explicit context.

nodes.name: formatMatchLine
nodes.summary: Truncates and assembles a match's before/match/after context into a display string within a target character budget, prioritizing keeping the matched text visible.

nodes.name: formatSearchMatch
nodes.summary: Normalizes a SearchMatch into display segments, preferring explicit context_before/context_after fields and falling back to deriving context from column ranges or the raw match text.

nodes.name: ManageKeysFooterAction.tsx
nodes.summary: React component rendering a preset spotlight footer action that closes the spotlight and navigates to the Key Vault / My Accounts integrations page, mirroring UnifiedModelPalette's handleManageKeys behavior.

nodes.name: ManageKeysFooterAction
nodes.summary: Functional component that renders a SpotlightFooterAction pill which closes the spotlight and either dispatches the APP_GO_TO_MODEL_KEYS action or navigates to the integrations path with the my-accounts models tab selected.

nodes.name: ManageModelsFooterAction.tsx
nodes.summary: React component rendering a preset spotlight footer action that closes the spotlight and navigates to the models integrations page, mirroring behavior copied from DispatchCategoryPalette and UnifiedModelPalette.

nodes.name: ManageModelsFooterAction
nodes.summary: Functional component that renders a SpotlightFooterAction pill which closes the spotlight and either dispatches the APP_GO_TO_INTEGRATIONS action or navigates directly to the models integrations path.

nodes.name: creatorDefaultModelAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persists the session creator's last-used model+source pair per dispatch category (cli_agent / rust_agent) using a two-tier localStorage write-through cache plus authoritative settings.jsonc storage, so the SessionCreator can pre-fill a default selection on new sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level synchronous cachedMap seeded from localStorage so the derived read atom returns data before the async Rust-backed settings RPC resolves.

nodes.name: recentModelEntriesAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persists the last 5 model+source selections to localStorage with Zod schema validation, powering the "Recent Models" one-click re-selection tab.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Zod schema transform to cap and validate the persisted array on read, guarding against corrupt or oversized localStorage payloads.

nodes.name: loadLocalStorageCache
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the localStorage write-through cache of the last model pair map, returning an empty map on missing or corrupt data.

nodes.name: deriveLastModelSelection
nodes.summary: Converts a stored RecentModelEntry into the read-only LastModelSelection shape consumed by dispatch hooks and creator UI, branching on hosted vs. own key source.

nodes.name: pruneStaleEntries
nodes.summary: Removes creator-default model entries whose account ID no longer exists among shared local keys, run once during startup hydration.

nodes.name: extractModelPair
nodes.summary: Extracts a validated RecentModelEntry (model+source pair) from an AdvancedConfig object, returning null when no meaningful selection exists.

nodes.name: recentEntriesEquivalent
nodes.summary: Determines whether two recent model entries represent the same account+model selection, used to dedupe the recent-entries list.

nodes.name: recordRecentEntry
nodes.summary: Inserts a new model+source selection at the front of the recent-entries list, deduping equivalent entries and capping the list at the max length.

nodes.name: shared.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared cross-cutting types (Person, Label, Team, ContextMenuItem, DropdownOption) reused across work items, projects, and UI components.

nodes.name: viewStatus.ts
nodes.summary: Provides unified status types and color palettes for Kanban, Gantt, Calendar, and List views, plus conversion utilities and helper functions mapping work item status to view-specific colors.
nodes.languageNotes: Consolidates per-view status enums into a single STATUS_COLORS palette and lookup maps, avoiding duplicated color logic across Kanban/Gantt/Calendar components.

nodes.name: fileManagerLabels.ts
nodes.summary: Defines localized label key sets for 'reveal in file manager' UI actions (Finder/Explorer/generic) and a helper that picks the right key set for the current OS.

nodes.name: getFileManagerRevealLabelKey
nodes.summary: Selects the OS-appropriate i18n label key (Finder, Explorer, or generic file manager) for reveal-in-file-manager UI actions, defaulting to the common key set.

nodes.name: binaryDetection.ts
nodes.summary: Detects binary files via extension heuristics and content sniffing, with async variants that delegate to a SIMD-accelerated Rust backend for fast detection on large files.
nodes.languageNotes: Pairs synchronous JS heuristics with async wrappers around Rust-side (Tauri) SIMD detection for a 10-20x speedup on large files.

nodes.name: pathUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Shared low-level helpers for parsing, decoding, and formatting file paths (octal-escape decoding, extension/name extraction, path segment/display helpers) consolidating duplicate logic across the codebase.

nodes.name: previewTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Determines the appropriate preview renderer (image, video, pdf, code, database, etc.) for a given file path and exposes capability checks used by the file preview UI.

nodes.name: repoPathDisplay.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes and formats repository-relative file paths for cross-platform display (Windows/POSIX separators, tilde-home shortening, tool-call argument extraction) used in UI labels and tool-call rendering.

nodes.name: isBinaryByExtension
nodes.summary: Synchronously determines if a file is binary by checking its extension against known binary extensions, a text-file allowlist, and binary filename patterns.

nodes.name: isBinaryContent
nodes.summary: Samples the beginning of file content and checks for null bytes or a high ratio of non-printable characters to detect binary content synchronously.

nodes.name: isTextFile
nodes.summary: Combines extension and content heuristics to decide whether a file should be treated as text (synchronous convenience wrapper).

nodes.name: getBinaryFileMessage
nodes.summary: Returns the user-facing message shown when a file is detected as binary and cannot be previewed as text.

nodes.name: isBinaryByExtensionAsync
nodes.summary: Async extension-based binary check that delegates to the Rust-backed checkBinaryByPath for performance, falling back to the sync heuristic.

nodes.name: isBinaryContentBytesAsync
nodes.summary: Async content-based binary check that delegates to the SIMD-accelerated Rust checkBinaryContentEnhanced function.

nodes.name: isFileBinaryAsync
nodes.summary: Performs a full async binary check (extension + content) on a file path via the Rust-accelerated checkFileIsBinaryEnhanced.

nodes.name: isTextFileAsync
nodes.summary: Async counterpart to isTextFile that combines the Rust-accelerated extension and content checks to determine if a file is text.

nodes.name: decodeOctalPath
nodes.summary: Decodes git/Rust-style backslash-octal-escaped byte sequences in a filename back into UTF-8 characters and strips surrounding quotes.

nodes.name: toFsPluginPath
nodes.summary: Converts a file:// URI or Windows UNC path into the plain path format expected by the Tauri filesystem plugin.

nodes.name: getFileExtension
nodes.summary: Extracts the file extension (without leading dot) from a file path.

nodes.name: getFileName
nodes.summary: Extracts the base file name from a path, handling both forward and backward slash separators.

nodes.name: getPathSegments
nodes.summary: Splits a normalized file path into its individual non-empty path segments.

nodes.name: getCompactPathLabel
nodes.summary: Produces a compact display label showing only the last N segments of a file path.

nodes.name: joinPathForDisplay
nodes.summary: Joins a parent directory path and child name into a single display path, avoiding duplicate separators.

nodes.name: normalizeDiffFilePath
nodes.summary: Strips git diff-style a/ and b/ path prefixes from a file path so it can be matched against the actual repo path.

nodes.name: getBaseName
nodes.summary: Returns the file name without its extension.

nodes.name: getDirectory
nodes.summary: Returns the parent directory portion of a file path.

nodes.name: getFileExtensionLower
nodes.summary: Returns the file extension in lowercase for case-insensitive extension comparisons.

nodes.name: getPreviewType
nodes.summary: Maps a file path to its PreviewType (image, video, pdf, database, code, binary, etc.) based on extension and platform capability, using binary detection as a fallback.

nodes.name: isPreviewableFile
nodes.summary: Checks whether a file path resolves to any renderable preview type.

nodes.name: supportsPreviewToggle
nodes.summary: Determines whether a file type supports toggling between raw source and rendered preview (json, csv, markdown, html).

nodes.name: isPreviewOnlyFile
nodes.summary: Identifies file types that can only be shown as a rendered preview with no editable source view (e.g. images, office documents).

nodes.name: requiresFilePreviewRoute
nodes.summary: Determines whether opening a file should navigate to a dedicated preview route instead of the editor.

nodes.name: supportsSourceControlWorkingCopyPreview
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given preview type can be diffed/previewed against its source-control working copy.

nodes.name: getImageMimeType
nodes.summary: Maps an image file's extension to its MIME type for use in preview rendering.

nodes.name: getVideoMimeType
nodes.summary: Maps a video file's extension to its MIME type for use in preview rendering.

nodes.name: normalizeDisplayPath
nodes.summary: Normalizes a path to forward slashes and trims whitespace for consistent cross-platform comparison.

nodes.name: getPlatformPathSeparator
nodes.summary: Returns the path separator character appropriate for the current OS (backslash on Windows, slash elsewhere).

nodes.name: formatPathForPlatformDisplay
nodes.summary: Converts a normalized forward-slash path to the platform-specific separator for display.

nodes.name: argSources
nodes.summary: Collects candidate argument objects from a tool-call args object, including common nested locations (input, params, arguments, tool_input, toolInput).

nodes.name: pickToolArgString
nodes.summary: Searches a tool-call arguments object (and its nested variants) for the first non-empty string value among the given keys.

nodes.name: resolveToolTargetPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the target file path referenced by a tool call, falling back to the repo path when no explicit path argument is found.

nodes.name: formatToolTargetPath
nodes.summary: Resolves and formats the display path for a tool call's target file, combining argument extraction with repo-relative display formatting.

nodes.name: formatRepoPathForDisplay
nodes.summary: Core formatter that converts an absolute or relative path into a repo-relative, platform-formatted display path with an optional root label and tilde-home shortening for out-of-repo paths.

nodes.name: compactRepoPathForDisplay
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper returning just the compact display path string from formatRepoPathForDisplay.

nodes.name: formatModelName.ts
nodes.summary: Formats raw model IDs into human-readable display labels (e.g. 'claude-opus-4.5-20251219' -> 'Opus 4.5'), stripping date stamps and hashes, merging version digit segments, and title-casing family names; also resolves display, pill, and full labels for model selections combined with account/provider info.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on regex-based normalization plus family-specific casing rules (Claude, GPT, O-series) rather than a lookup table.

nodes.name: formatClaudeModelName
nodes.summary: Formats a cleaned Claude model id remainder into a display string by extracting model family, version, and codename tokens.

nodes.name: formatModelName
nodes.summary: Main entry point that strips trailing junk from a raw model id and title-cases the remaining tokens into a compact display name, special-casing Claude models.

nodes.name: formatModelNameFull
nodes.summary: Produces the full display name for a model id, appending a formatted snapshot date suffix when present.

nodes.name: normalizeClaudeFamilyLabel
nodes.summary: Normalizes casing of a Claude family label (e.g. 'OPUS' -> 'Opus').

nodes.name: compactModelLabel
nodes.summary: Produces a short model label by normalizing the Claude family portion and trimming trailing detail from a full label string.

nodes.name: extractModelVersion
nodes.summary: Extracts the family name and numeric version from a model id string for use in version-based sorting.

nodes.name: compareModelsByVersion
nodes.summary: Comparator that orders two model ids by family name then descending version, using extractModelVersion.

nodes.name: resolveModelDisplayLabel
nodes.summary: Resolves the display label for a model selection, preferring a provider-configured alias and falling back through provider model lists and default formatting.

nodes.name: resolveModelGroupLabel
nodes.summary: Resolves the model-group label (e.g. 'Opus 4.5') for a given model id by parsing its variant and grouping it against known models.

nodes.name: resolveModelPillDisplayParts
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered label parts (variant flags plus group label) used to render a model selection as a compact UI pill.

nodes.name: resolveModelPillLabel
nodes.summary: Joins the resolved pill display parts into a single label string for a model selection.

nodes.name: resolveModelPillAccountName
nodes.summary: Extracts the account name to show alongside a model pill, if the selection carries one.

nodes.name: resolveModelFullLabel
nodes.summary: Resolves the full descriptive label for a model selection, combining alias lookups and full formatted names with a fallback.

nodes.name: modelGrouping.ts
nodes.summary: Groups model names by family and version (e.g. 'Opus 4.6', 'GPT 5.3'), sorts groups by version or enabled state, classifies legacy groups, and computes the default set of enabled models for the model picker UI.

nodes.name: extractGptModelTier
nodes.summary: Extracts the GPT model tier (mini, nano, etc.) from a model name remainder.

nodes.name: parseClaude
nodes.summary: Parses the remainder of a Claude model name into a group label and numeric sort version, handling thinking/legacy suffix variants.

nodes.name: parseModelGroup
nodes.summary: Dispatches a lowercased model name to family-specific parsing logic (Claude, Cursor-tier, GPT, generic versioned) to build a ModelGroup label and sort version.

nodes.name: groupModels
nodes.summary: Groups a flat list of model names into ModelGroup buckets keyed by label, sorted by descending version.

nodes.name: sortModelGroups
nodes.summary: Sorts model groups either alphabetically or by enabled-state-first, based on the given sort mode.

nodes.name: isUncategorizedModelGroup
nodes.summary: Predicate that checks whether a model group represents the catch-all 'uncategorized' bucket.

nodes.name: getDefaultEnabledModels
nodes.summary: Computes the default enabled model set by picking the newest non-legacy, dated model from each group.

nodes.name: isLegacyGroup
nodes.summary: Predicate that detects whether a model group label refers to a legacy or O-series generation.

nodes.name: getModelFamily
nodes.summary: Derives a canonical family key (e.g. 'claude', 'gpt', 'o-series') from a raw model name.

nodes.name: modelNameHasSnapshotDate
nodes.summary: Predicate that tests whether a model name ends with a snapshot date pattern.

nodes.name: modelVariants.ts
nodes.summary: Parses model IDs into structured variant metadata (base model, reasoning level, thinking/fast flags) across Claude, GPT, Composer, and O-series families, and formats that metadata back into display labels for the model selection UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses per-family suffix-token parsers (buildVariant) sharing a common token-merging pipeline, dispatched by parseModelVariant.

nodes.name: normalizeReasoning
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw reasoning suffix token or string into a canonical ModelReasoningLevel value.

nodes.name: collectSuffixTokens
nodes.summary: Pops recognized variant suffix tokens (fast, thinking, reasoning levels) off the end of a model name's segments, leaving the base model segments behind.

nodes.name: mergeCompoundTokens
nodes.summary: Merges adjacent suffix tokens (e.g. 'extra' + 'high') into single compound tokens like 'extra_high'.

nodes.name: buildVariant
nodes.summary: Constructs a ModelVariantMetadata object from a model id, base model, and raw suffix tokens, resolving fast/thinking flags and reasoning level.

nodes.name: parseSuffixOnlyFamilyVariant
nodes.summary: Parses variant metadata for model families identified purely by a known prefix, using only suffix-token extraction.

nodes.name: parseGptVariant
nodes.summary: Parses a GPT-family model id into variant metadata, extracting tier via extractGptModelTier and reasoning/fast suffix tokens.

nodes.name: parseComposerVariant
nodes.summary: Parses a Composer-family model id into variant metadata.

nodes.name: parseOSeriesVariant
nodes.summary: Parses an O-series (o1/o3/o4) model id into variant metadata, including size suffixes and reasoning tokens.

nodes.name: parseModelVariant
nodes.summary: Dispatches a raw model id to the correct family-specific variant parser (GPT, Composer, O-series, Claude, suffix-only) and returns the resulting metadata.

nodes.name: parseModelVariants
nodes.summary: Maps parseModelVariant across a list of model ids, filtering out unparseable entries.

nodes.name: getModelVariantBaseModel
nodes.summary: Returns the base model id for a given model id by parsing its variant metadata.

nodes.name: toModelReasoningLevel
nodes.summary: Coerces an arbitrary value into a valid ModelReasoningLevel via normalizeReasoning.

nodes.name: formatReasoningLevel
nodes.summary: Formats a ModelReasoningLevel enum value into a human-readable label (e.g. 'Extra High') for display in the UI.

nodes.name: modelVariantsByModel
nodes.summary: Builds a Map from model id to ModelVariantMetadata for fast lookup from an array of variants.

nodes.name: formatVariantDisplayLabel
nodes.summary: Builds a combined display label (e.g. 'Thinking · High') describing a model id's parsed variant.

nodes.name: resolveModelVariantFields
nodes.summary: Resolves the thinking/reasoning/fast field values for a model id, falling back to a provided fallback model's variant metadata when the primary model doesn't parse.

nodes.name: groupHasParsedModelVariants
nodes.summary: Predicate that checks whether any model in a list parses successfully as a known variant.

nodes.name: variantEditOptions.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the availability matrix (reasoning levels present, fast-variant availability per level, none-variant flag, and selection-to-model-id resolution) consumed by the model variant-edit dropdown UI for a given family's model ids.

nodes.name: indexVariants
nodes.summary: Parses a family's model ids into indexed variant records (parsed metadata plus original id) for later lookup and matrix building.

nodes.name: selectionKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable string key from a partial variant selection (thinking, level, fast) for use in map lookups.

nodes.name: buildVariantEditOptions
nodes.summary: Main exported function that walks a family's model ids and produces the full VariantEditOptions object (available reasoning levels, per-level fast availability, none-variant flag, and a selection-to-model-id resolver) for the variant-edit dropdown.

nodes.name: json.rs
nodes.summary: Shared JSON file I/O helpers for reading, writing, and recursively merging JSON, plus an atomic-write sensitive key-value store used for auth tokens and secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: save_json_store uses a write-to-temp-then-rename pattern for atomicity and restricts file permissions on the temp file before the rename.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for app-utils, a leaf utility crate shared across the workspace; declares the json and (feature-gated) testing modules and hosts a small serde default_true helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Crate is intentionally kept as a dependency-free leaf (only depends on app_paths) so it can be reused by any other workspace crate without cycle risk.

nodes.name: testing.rs
nodes.summary: Feature-gated ("testing") helper that materializes a temporary directory populated with given file contents, for use in unit/integration tests across the workspace.

nodes.name: read_json_file
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a JSON file at the given path, returning an empty JSON object if the file does not exist.

nodes.name: write_json_file
nodes.summary: Serializes a serde_json::Value as pretty-printed JSON and writes it to disk, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: merge_json
nodes.summary: Recursively merges a partial JSON object into a base JSON object, merging nested objects and overwriting other value types.

nodes.name: save_json_store
nodes.summary: Atomically writes a HashMap<String, String> as JSON with restricted file permissions, used for sensitive key-value stores such as auth tokens and secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes to a .tmp file, applies restrictive permissions, then renames over the target for crash-safe atomic replacement.

nodes.name: load_json_store
nodes.summary: Loads a HashMap<String, String> from a JSON file, returning an empty map if the file is missing, and logging distinct warnings on read failure vs. parse failure so a corrupt store isn't silently wiped by the next save.

nodes.name: default_true
nodes.summary: Serde default-value helper that returns true, intended for use with #[serde(default = "app_utils::default_true")] on bool fields treated as enabled-by-default.

nodes.name: temp_dir_with_files
nodes.summary: Creates a temporary directory and populates it with the given relative-path/content file entries, returning the directory path for use in tests.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Defines four Tauri IPC commands (inbox_list, inbox_upsert, inbox_update_status, inbox_delete) that expose inbox message CRUD operations to the frontend, delegating SQLite work to the persistence module via spawn_blocking.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the inbox module; declares the commands and persistence submodules and initializes the SQLite inbox_messages table with status/category/created_at indexes in the shared database.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root (lib.rs) that wires together sibling submodules via pub mod declarations.

nodes.name: persistence.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite CRUD layer for inbox messages: defines the InboxMessage record type and functions to upsert, list (capped at 200, newest first), update status, and delete messages using the shared database connection.

nodes.name: inbox_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists inbox messages by delegating to persistence::list_messages on a blocking task and mapping errors to strings for the frontend.

nodes.name: inbox_upsert
nodes.summary: Tauri command that inserts or updates an inbox message by calling persistence::upsert_message on a blocking task.

nodes.name: inbox_update_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command that updates an inbox message's status field via persistence::update_status.

nodes.name: inbox_delete
nodes.summary: Tauri command that deletes an inbox message by ID via persistence::delete_message.

nodes.name: init_inbox_tables
nodes.summary: Creates the inbox_messages SQLite table and its status/category/created_at indexes if they do not already exist.

nodes.name: upsert_message
nodes.summary: Inserts a new inbox message or updates an existing one on conflict, preserving fields while refreshing updated_at with the current timestamp.

nodes.name: list_messages
nodes.summary: Queries all inbox messages ordered by created_at descending, capped at 200 rows, and maps each row into an InboxMessage.

nodes.name: update_status
nodes.summary: Updates the status and updated_at timestamp of an inbox message by ID.

nodes.name: delete_message
nodes.summary: Deletes an inbox message by ID from the inbox_messages table.

nodes.name: delete_by_status
nodes.summary: Deletes all inbox messages matching a given status (e.g., to purge archived messages) and returns the number of rows removed.

nodes.name: InboxMessage
nodes.summary: Serializable record representing an inbox message with id, title, preview, content, category, priority, status, sender, JSON-encoded metadata/labels, and timestamps; serialized to camelCase for the frontend.

nodes.name: browser_state.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AgentBrowserController, which manages an agent-browser or Playwright CLI subprocess for browser automation: starting/stopping the session, allocating a local port, and exposing high-level actions (navigate, snapshot, screenshot, click, type, select, evaluate) by shelling out to the CLI and parsing its JSON responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AtomicBool for lock-free paused-state tracking and a hand-rolled quote-aware tokenizer (split_browser_cli_command) instead of a shell dependency.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the shared-state crate; declares the browser_state and screenshot_state modules and re-exports their public types so the agent_core and browser crates can share runtime state without depending on each other.

nodes.name: screenshot_state.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ScreenshotStore, a byte-capped in-memory cache backed by disk persistence for captured screenshots, with methods to store JPEG/typed-MIME screenshots and retrieve them as raw bytes or base64 data URIs.

nodes.name: BrowserAutomationProvider
nodes.summary: Enum selecting between the AgentBrowser and Playwright automation backends, with parsing helpers from environment variables and settings strings.

nodes.name: AgentBrowserConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct capturing which browser automation provider is active plus optional custom CLI paths, loaded from persisted app settings or environment defaults.

nodes.name: BrowserCliConfig
nodes.summary: Resolved CLI configuration describing which executable to run and whether a Node-based launcher wrapper is required for the active browser automation provider.

nodes.name: BrowserCliOutput
nodes.summary: Captures the exit status, stdout, and stderr of a browser CLI subprocess invocation, with a helper to render them as tool-friendly text.

nodes.name: AgentBrowserController
nodes.summary: Central controller owning the agent-browser/Playwright CLI subprocess lifecycle: starts, stops, and pauses browser automation, allocates a local port, and exposes high-level browser actions by shelling out to the CLI and parsing its JSON responses.

nodes.name: ScreenshotEntry
nodes.summary: Plain data record for a single captured screenshot: id, source URL, JPEG bytes, and capture timestamp.

nodes.name: ScreenshotStore
nodes.summary: Thread-safe store combining a byte-capped in-memory ring buffer with disk persistence for screenshots, exposing store/get APIs that return raw bytes or base64 data URIs.

nodes.name: from_settings
nodes.summary: Builds an AgentBrowserConfig by combining the provider from an environment/settings override with optional agent-browser and Playwright CLI paths read from persisted settings.

nodes.name: as_tool_text
nodes.summary: Formats a BrowserCliOutput's stdout/stderr into a single human-readable text block for surfacing CLI results to an agent tool caller.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a default AgentBrowserController with an auto-selected browser automation provider and no active CLI session.

nodes.name: set_provider
nodes.summary: Switches the active browser automation provider, refusing the change while a CLI session is already running.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the browser automation session by resolving the CLI config, verifying the agent-browser executable is usable, and allocating a listening port.

nodes.name: cli_request
nodes.summary: Dispatches a generic REST-style request (navigate/screenshot/act/tabs/etc.) to the active browser CLI session based on HTTP method and path, returning the parsed JSON result.

nodes.name: cli_get_with_query
nodes.summary: Routes GET requests with query parameters to the appropriate CLI subcommand, such as accessibility snapshot or console log retrieval.

nodes.name: cli_open
nodes.summary: Runs the browser CLI 'open' command to navigate the automated browser to a given URL.

nodes.name: cli_snapshot
nodes.summary: Runs the accessibility snapshot CLI command with optional interactive/compact/selector flags and returns the parsed snapshot JSON.

nodes.name: cli_screenshot
nodes.summary: Captures a screenshot via the CLI to a temp file, reads the raw bytes back, cleans up the temp file, and attaches the current page URL to the result.

nodes.name: cli_act
nodes.summary: Large action dispatcher that translates a structured action request (click, type, fill, hover, drag, select, key press, wait, evaluate, navigate-back) into the corresponding browser CLI subcommand invocation and returns the post-action page state.

nodes.name: cli_tabs
nodes.summary: Runs the CLI 'tabs' command and normalizes its JSON response into a list of open browser tabs.

nodes.name: cli_console
nodes.summary: Runs the CLI console-log command and normalizes its response into a list of console messages/entries.

nodes.name: run_cli_command
nodes.summary: Executes a raw agent-browser/Playwright CLI command via run_browser_cli_command, parses the JSON stdout, and surfaces a success/error Result with the extracted data payload.

nodes.name: find_available_port
nodes.summary: Scans a range of ports starting from a preferred value to find one that's free for the local browser automation server to bind to.

nodes.name: is_port_available
nodes.summary: Checks whether a TCP port on localhost is free by attempting to bind a listener to it.

nodes.name: verify_agent_browser_cli
nodes.summary: Runs the agent-browser CLI with --version to confirm the configured executable is present and functional, returning its version string or the failure output.

nodes.name: resolve_browser_cli_config
nodes.summary: Resolves the concrete BrowserCliConfig (executable path and launcher requirements) for the selected provider by delegating to provider-specific path resolution.

nodes.name: run_browser_cli_command
nodes.summary: Low-level subprocess runner that builds and executes the agent-browser/Playwright CLI command with the session id, JSON flag, environment (including a resolved local Chrome path), and returns captured stdout/stderr/exit status.

nodes.name: split_browser_cli_command
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a shell-style command string (respecting single/double quotes) into an argument vector for invoking the browser CLI.
nodes.languageNotes: Character-by-character quote-aware state machine implemented without a shell-parsing crate dependency.

nodes.name: resolve_agent_browser_cli
nodes.summary: Determines the path to the agent-browser CLI executable, checking an explicit config path, an environment variable override, and vendored sidecar locations in order.

nodes.name: resolve_playwright_cli
nodes.summary: Determines the path to the Playwright CLI script, checking explicit config, environment variable, and known dev-mode locations before falling back to a default.

nodes.name: playwright_cli_dev_paths
nodes.summary: Lists candidate filesystem locations where the Playwright CLI script might live during local development.

nodes.name: playwright_cli_config_from_path
nodes.summary: Builds a BrowserCliConfig for the Playwright provider from a resolved script path, marking whether a Node launcher wrapper is needed based on the file extension.

nodes.name: vendored_agent_browser_paths
nodes.summary: Enumerates platform-specific vendored/sidecar install locations for the agent-browser executable, including macOS app-bundle Resources paths and a src-tauri-relative bin directory.

nodes.name: resolve_local_chrome_path
nodes.summary: Locates a locally installed Chrome/Chromium executable via environment override or a list of common platform-specific install paths.

nodes.name: prune_memory_entries
nodes.summary: Evicts the oldest in-memory screenshot entries from the ring buffer until total buffered JPEG bytes drop within the configured cap.

nodes.name: store
nodes.summary: Persists a new JPEG screenshot to disk and appends its metadata to the in-memory entry list, generating a short UUID id and millisecond timestamp, then prunes over-capacity entries.

nodes.name: store_with_mime
nodes.summary: Persists a screenshot of an arbitrary MIME type to disk, writing both the bytes and a sidecar .mime file, and records it in the in-memory entry list.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Retrieves a screenshot's bytes and URL by id, checking the in-memory cache first and falling back to reading the bytes from disk.

nodes.name: sseSchemas.ts
nodes.summary: Defines Zod schemas and typed parse helpers for the four Server-Sent Event payload shapes (start, output, end, error) emitted by the Rust IDE HTTP server.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Zod v4 with .catchall(z.unknown()) to permit forward-compatible extra fields on end/error payloads, and z.output<> to derive TS types directly from the runtime schemas.

nodes.name: taskStreaming.ts
nodes.summary: Task execution streaming API that builds SSE endpoint URLs for the Rust /api/tasks server and exposes taskRunStream plus npm/yarn/pnpm convenience wrappers for streaming shell task output in real time.

nodes.name: parseSSEStartData
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the raw JSON string of an SSE 'start' event against SSEStartDataSchema.

nodes.name: parseSSEOutputData
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the raw JSON string of an SSE 'output' event (stream + line) against SSEOutputDataSchema.

nodes.name: parseSSEEndData
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the raw JSON string of an SSE 'end' event (success flag plus optional error_type) against SSEEndDataSchema.

nodes.name: parseSSEErrorData
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the raw JSON string of an SSE 'error' event against SSEErrorDataSchema.

nodes.name: taskRunStream
nodes.summary: Builds the /api/tasks/:id/run/stream URL with query parameters and delegates to createSSEStream, adapting its callbacks to task-specific onStart/onOutput/onComplete/onError semantics.

nodes.name: npmRunStream
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around taskRunStream that runs an npm script (`npm run <script>`) with streaming output.

nodes.name: yarnRunStream
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around taskRunStream that runs a yarn script (`yarn <script>`) with streaming output.

nodes.name: pnpmRunStream
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around taskRunStream that runs a pnpm script (`pnpm <script>`) with streaming output.

nodes.name: backgroundColors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the stable set of app background color presets (id, label, description, CSS variable slot) and helpers to look up a preset by id and resolve it to a CSS var() expression.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `as const satisfies BackgroundColorPreset[]` to keep preset ids narrowed to a literal union while still validating shape against the interface.

nodes.name: getBackgroundColorPresetById
nodes.summary: Looks up a background color preset by its string id, returning null when the id is missing or unmatched.

nodes.name: resolveBackgroundColorPreset
nodes.summary: Resolves a background color preset to its CSS `var(--app-bg-N)` expression.

nodes.name: primaryColorSchemas.ts
nodes.summary: Maps each background color preset id to a curated primary color schema, pregenerating an 'accent follows background' lookup table from the primary color palettes.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds the exported lookup table eagerly at module load via an IIFE-style function call so the shared palette objects are reused (shared memory) rather than deep-copied.

nodes.name: buildBackgroundColorSchemas
nodes.summary: Builds the full background-color-id to primary-color-schema record by resolving each curated preset name against the primary color palettes.

nodes.name: getPrimarySchemaForBackgroundColorId
nodes.summary: Safely retrieves the primary color schema for a given background color id, returning null when the id is missing or unrecognized.

nodes.name: primaryColors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the primary color preset names, CSS variable keys, and light/dark hex palette data (PRIMARY_COLOR_PALETTES) used to build the app's primary color ramps, plus the default preset.
nodes.languageNotes: Large file of literal hex palette constants (light/dark ramps) exported as typed `PrimaryColorSchema` objects consumed by primaryColorSchemas.ts.

nodes.name: RecipeRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Data-driven event renderer component that resolves a tool's uiCanonical and action name from raw event props, looks up the corresponding ChatBlock from the Rust tool registry, and dispatches rendering to the matching Block component.
nodes.languageNotes: Adding a new tool that reuses an existing Block requires zero frontend changes; only Rust's tool registry needs to set chat_block.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting all chat block adapter components (ReadFileAdapter, ShellAdapter, OrgTaskAdapter, DiffAdapter, etc.) that wrap Block components with pre-translated labels from the Rust tool registry.

nodes.name: chatBlocks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines CHAT_BLOCKS, a lookup map from each ChatBlock variant (read_file, diff, shell, org_task, etc.) to its adapter component, plus a FALLBACK_BLOCK and a hidden-block sentinel, used by RecipeRenderer to select which Block to render.

nodes.name: extractActualToolName
nodes.summary: Resolves the actual tool/function name from raw event props by checking functionName, nested event.functionName, and function fields in priority order, falling back to the generic 'tool_call' sentinel.

nodes.name: extractAction
nodes.summary: Derives the action name for a normalized event, first via deriveToolAction, then falling back to matching an '[action: x]' marker in the result output or content string.

nodes.name: RecipeRenderer
nodes.summary: React functional component that normalizes raw event props, resolves the uiCanonical/tool/action combination, looks up the matching ChatBlock via getActionChatBlock with fallbacks, and renders the resolved Block component.

nodes.name: hooks.tsx
nodes.summary: React hook and supporting components (lazy loader, error boundary) that render Simulator session events by resolving them through the unified event registry with caching, Suspense, and error handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a WeakMap-backed key cache and a class-based error boundary alongside functional hooks/components in the same module.

nodes.name: LazyEventComponent
nodes.summary: React component that lazily resolves and renders the component for a given event type, managing loading and cached states via getEventComponentSync/loadEventComponent.

nodes.name: getStableEventKey
nodes.summary: Derives a stable React list key for an event, preferring id/chunk_id fields and falling back to a WeakMap-cached generated key to avoid unnecessary remounts.

nodes.name: useUnifiedEventRenderer
nodes.summary: Main hook returning a memoized renderEvent function that resolves an event's type, looks up its registered component and context config, and wraps rendering in an error boundary and Suspense.

nodes.name: UnifiedErrorBoundary
nodes.summary: React error boundary that catches rendering failures for a given event type, logs them, and displays a fallback alert instead of crashing the tree.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Shared configuration constants and CSS class helper functions for all SimulatorFrame variants, including the frame radius-to-Tailwind-class mapping.

nodes.name: getSimulatorFrameContainerClasses
nodes.summary: Builds the Tailwind class string for a simulator frame's outer container based on the selected border radius option.

nodes.name: getSimulatorFrameContentClasses
nodes.summary: Returns the fixed Tailwind class string used for a simulator frame's scrollable content area.

nodes.name: serviceAuthAtoms.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the shared Jotai atoms backing global service-auth state (authenticated flag, token, expiry, error, loading/refreshing flags), plus a helper that clears both localStorage and the atoms atomically and a read-only hook for observing the state.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jotai's getDefaultStore() to imperatively write atom values outside of React component render, enabling synchronous auth-state clearing during logout.

nodes.name: clearAuthStateCompletely
nodes.summary: Clears the hosted auth token and secure tokens from storage, then resets all service-auth Jotai atoms to their signed-out defaults.

nodes.name: useServiceAuthState
nodes.summary: Read-only hook that reads all service-auth atoms and returns a consolidated auth-state object, without triggering side effects or network calls.

nodes.name: serviceAuthHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for normalizing and classifying auth-related errors (network, auth, missing-refresh-token) plus a promise-based sleep helper used for retry backoff in the auth refresh flow.

nodes.name: getErrorMessage
nodes.summary: Normalizes an unknown error value (Error instance, string, or other) into a lowercase message string for pattern matching.

nodes.name: isNetworkError
nodes.summary: Detects whether an error looks like a network/connectivity failure by matching known substrings (fetch, timeout, offline, etc.) in its message.

nodes.name: isAuthError
nodes.summary: Detects whether an error indicates an authentication/authorization failure (e.g. unauthorized, invalid token) based on its message text.

nodes.name: isNoRefreshTokenError
nodes.summary: Detects the specific error case where no refresh token is available, used to short-circuit retry logic in the auth refresh flow.

nodes.name: sleep
nodes.summary: Promise-based delay helper used to implement exponential backoff between auth token refresh retries.

nodes.name: useDropdownAutoKeyboard.ts
nodes.summary: Zero-config keyboard navigation fallback for dropdown panels that don't pass an explicit listNavigation config to useDropdownEngine; discovers focusable rows via DOM query, tracks a highlighted row, and drives Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Escape handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses capture-phase document keydown listeners plus data-attribute driven DOM highlighting rather than React state for the visual highlight, to stay in sync with hover without re-rendering rows.

nodes.name: useDropdownListNavigation.ts
nodes.summary: Adds ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, and Enter keyboard navigation to dropdowns built on useDropdownEngine, providing selectedIndex state and per-item prop getters, mirroring Spotlight's useListNavigation contract.
nodes.languageNotes: View-agnostic: exposes getItemProps/getPanelProps prop getters rather than rendering markup, and deliberately leaves Escape handling to useDropdownEngine to keep ownership single.

nodes.name: queryRows
nodes.summary: Queries the dropdown panel DOM for focusable, selectable rows (buttons/menuitem/option elements), excluding disabled or keyboard-skip-flagged nodes.

nodes.name: shouldBailForEditableTarget
nodes.summary: Determines whether a keydown event should be ignored because its target is an editable element where the key has a native text-editing effect.

nodes.name: useDropdownAutoKeyboard
nodes.summary: React hook implementing zero-config keyboard highlight navigation for a dropdown panel: tracks a highlighted row index, wires document-level keydown capture for Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Escape, and dispatches a synthetic click on the highlighted row for Enter.

nodes.name: findSelectable
nodes.summary: Searches a list of items from a start index in a given direction for the next item accepted by an isItemSelectable predicate, skipping disabled or non-selectable entries.

nodes.name: useDropdownListNavigation
nodes.summary: React hook adding Arrow/Home/End/Enter keyboard navigation and hover-synced selection to dropdown item lists, returning selectedIndex state plus getItemProps/getPanelProps prop getters.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines default configuration values for the Housekeeper AI assistant feature, including the default local model, base URL, safe context token limit, confidence threshold, and the whitelist of ActionSystem actions the assistant is allowed to trigger.

nodes.name: useHousekeeperConfig.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that resolves Housekeeper AI assistant settings, auto-detecting a suitable local vLLM/MiniCPM key-vault account and model, and exposes persisted feature toggles for prompt polish, step explain, UI control, and context compaction.

nodes.name: useHousekeeperUiControl.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that lets the Housekeeper AI assistant drive the app UI from natural-language text by classifying user intent into an allow-listed action and dispatching it through the ActionSystem.

nodes.name: getHousekeeperModelCandidates
nodes.summary: Collects a deduplicated list of candidate model names for a key-vault account from its enabled, available, and variant model fields.

nodes.name: useHousekeeperConfig
nodes.summary: Hook that reads persisted Housekeeper settings, auto-selects a ready vLLM key-vault account running a MiniCPM model, resolves the effective account/model, and returns config state, setters, and feature flags.

nodes.name: useHousekeeperUiControl
nodes.summary: Hook exposing tryRunHousekeeperUiControl, which sends free-text user input to the housekeeper UI-intent API, validates the returned action against an allow-list and confidence threshold, and dispatches it via the ActionSystem.

nodes.name: modelPairCompatibility.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared compatibility predicates that determine whether a stored model+source pair (ORGII tier, hosted key, or own-key account) is still usable in the current dispatch context.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure predicate module (no React) shared between a hook and a UI component to keep compatibility logic in one place.

nodes.name: useOrgiiPoolCategories.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that fetches and caches ORGII pool category config, exposing the raw category list plus memoized lookup structures (model-to-category map, tier-id set) for compatibility checks and the model palette Recent tab.

nodes.name: useValidatedLastPair.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that revalidates the last-used model+source pair against currently available accounts and ORGII pool config, returning null if the stored pair is no longer compatible so stale selections never surface in the UI.

nodes.name: resolveCompatibleOwnKeyAccount
nodes.summary: Finds a KeyVault account matching a recent model pair's stored account id (or falls back to name+type), requiring ready status, an active key, and the model being enabled on that account.

nodes.name: isPairCompatible
nodes.summary: Determines whether a model+source pair is compatible with the current context by branching on ORGII tier model, hosted-key source, or own-key account resolution.

nodes.name: useOrgiiPoolCategories
nodes.summary: Hook returning ORGII pool categories with memoized lookup structures; lazily fetches config once via getORGIIPoolConfig (preferring a cached value) and skips fetching entirely when disabled.

nodes.name: useValidatedLastPair
nodes.summary: Resolves compatible accounts for the current dispatch category, conditionally loads ORGII pool config only when the stored pair actually needs it, and returns a rebuilt LastModelSelection or null based on compatibility validation.

nodes.name: useSidebarMemoryEntry.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that registers a sidebar UI section's estimated memory footprint with the shared sidebar memory tracker on mount/update and removes it on unmount, keyed by a stable per-instance symbol.

nodes.name: useSidebarMemoryEntry
nodes.summary: Registers a sidebar section's estimated render memory footprint on mount/update, keyed by a stable per-instance symbol, and unregisters it on unmount.

nodes.name: useCollabOutboxPending.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that tracks pending (unsynced) collaboration outbox project and work-item IDs across a set of organizations, refreshing on project-data-change and outbox-flush events.

nodes.name: useCollabOutboxPending
nodes.summary: Hook that polls projectApi.listCollabOutboxPendingIds per organization, computes pending project/work-item ID sets, and re-subscribes to project-data-changed and outbox-flushed events to keep the sets fresh.

nodes.name: useAppearanceState.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook centralizing appearance-related state (global theme, primary color, UI scale, application font, spotlight placement) sourced from jotai atoms, plus memoized option lists and handlers for changing theme/appearance mode with a CSS swap transition.

nodes.name: useAppearanceState
nodes.summary: Exported hook returning appearance state (theme, primary color, UI scale, application font, spotlight placement) and change handlers, including an async handleThemeChange that shows a theme transition cover, swaps CSS, and batch-updates settings.

nodes.name: SessionGroupPage.tsx
nodes.summary: React component that renders a titled page shell with header, subtitle, action buttons, and an optional toolbar, wrapping a search-enabled SessionTable for browsing and selecting agent sessions.

nodes.name: SessionGroupPage
nodes.summary: Renders the page header (title, subtitle, action buttons) and optional toolbar, then embeds a SessionTable configured with search and fill-height enabled to display the passed session items.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Project Manager simulator app configuration, deriving project/work-item replay state from session events using the Rust tool registry (getAppTypeForTool) as the source of truth for event matching.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the shared ProjectOperation and SimulatorProjectState types from the core Simulator app types module for use within the Session Replay project feature.

nodes.name: extractProjectOp
nodes.summary: Matches a session event against the Project Manager app type and extracts a normalized ProjectOperation record (action, result text, error flag, project/work-item names) for replay rendering.

nodes.name: deriveProjectState
nodes.summary: Derives the simulator's project-replay state by extracting ProjectOperation entries from a list of session events and selecting the operation matching the current event.

nodes.name: MarkdownRuleForm.tsx
nodes.summary: React form component rendering the markdown policy-rule editor: source (user/repo/personal) picker, agent/repo selectors, rule name field, and an embedded markdown editor with tabs.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Wizard component for creating/editing markdown policy rules; wraps MarkdownRuleForm in a WizardShell, manages local form state, and validates before invoking the save callback.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions (MarkdownRuleData, MarkdownRuleState, PolicyRuleWizardProps) and a default-state factory for the markdown policy rule wizard.

nodes.name: MarkdownRuleForm
nodes.summary: Default-exported React component that renders the markdown rule form fields (source, agents, repo, name, content) and calls onChange with an updated MarkdownRuleState on edits.

nodes.name: PolicyRuleWizard
nodes.summary: Default-exported wizard component that initializes markdown rule state, validates the name/repo requirements, and dispatches the save payload to onSaveMarkdownRule.

nodes.name: defaultMarkdownRuleState
nodes.summary: Builds the initial MarkdownRuleState from an optional existing MarkdownRuleData, resolving the matching repo by path for workspace-scoped rules.

nodes.name: dragSideChannel.ts
nodes.summary: Window-scoped side-channel store for drag-and-drop state (internal file-tree drags, workstation tab drags, and time-limited PR/issue reference stashes) that lets React drag handlers communicate outside the standard HTML5 DataTransfer API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ad-hoc window globals as a same-window side channel to work around HTML5 DataTransfer's synchronous, read-restricted-during-dragover behavior; PR/issue stashes are TTL-guarded (30s) to avoid stale reference data leaking into unrelated drops.

nodes.name: referenceDragData.ts
nodes.summary: Parses and normalizes PR/issue reference drag payloads from DataTransfer objects (or the side-channel stash) into typed pill data used to render reference chips during drag-and-drop.

nodes.name: setInternalFileTreeDrag
nodes.summary: Marks an internal file-tree drag as active and stashes its JSON-serialized payload on the window object.

nodes.name: isInternalFileTreeDragActive
nodes.summary: Reports whether an internal file-tree drag is currently active.

nodes.name: clearInternalFileTreeDrag
nodes.summary: Clears the internal file-tree drag flag and its stashed payload.

nodes.name: consumeInternalFileTreeDragData
nodes.summary: Reads and clears the stashed internal file-tree drag JSON payload in one atomic consume operation.

nodes.name: setWorkstationTabDrag
nodes.summary: Marks a workstation tab drag as active and stashes its JSON-serialized payload on the window object.

nodes.name: isWorkstationTabDragActive
nodes.summary: Reports whether a workstation tab drag is currently active.

nodes.name: clearWorkstationTabDrag
nodes.summary: Clears the workstation tab drag flag and its stashed payload.

nodes.name: consumeWorkstationTabDragData
nodes.summary: Reads the stashed workstation tab drag payload and clears it via clearWorkstationTabDrag.

nodes.name: hasFreshReferenceDragStash
nodes.summary: Reports whether a non-expired PR or issue reference drag stash currently exists.

nodes.name: getFreshPrDragStash
nodes.summary: Returns the stashed PR reference drag payload if it has not exceeded the TTL, otherwise undefined.

nodes.name: getFreshIssueDragStash
nodes.summary: Returns the stashed issue reference drag payload if it has not exceeded the TTL, otherwise undefined.

nodes.name: setPrDragStash
nodes.summary: Stashes a PR reference drag payload with a timestamp so it can be retrieved by a later drop handler.

nodes.name: setIssueDragStash
nodes.summary: Stashes an issue reference drag payload with a timestamp so it can be retrieved by a later drop handler.

nodes.name: clearPrDragStash
nodes.summary: Clears the stashed PR reference drag payload.

nodes.name: clearIssueDragStash
nodes.summary: Clears the stashed issue reference drag payload.

nodes.name: hasReferenceDragData
nodes.summary: Determines whether PR or issue reference drag data is available, checking the live side-channel stash and the reported DataTransfer MIME types.

nodes.name: getReferenceDragData
nodes.summary: Extracts raw reference drag data for a given type from DataTransfer, falling back to the plain-text encoding and then to the fresh side-channel stash.

nodes.name: getReferenceDragPillData
nodes.summary: Resolves a dropped DataTransfer into typed PR or issue reference pill data, trying the PR MIME type first and falling back to the issue type.

nodes.name: clearReferenceDragData
